377:   // ── exploration loop ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
378:   loop(now) {
379:     const dt = Math.min(0.06, Math.max(0, (now - this.lastTime) / 1000))
380:     this.lastTime = now
381:     if (this.mode === 'game' && this.state && this.world && this.renderer) {
382:       const blocked = isModalOpen() || !!this.battleUI
383:       if (!blocked) {
384:         this.handleMovement(dt)
385:         const result = this.world.update(dt)
386:         this.near = result.near
387:         if (result.encounter) this.startWildBattle(result.encounter)
388:       } else {
389:         this.playerMoving = false
390:       }
391:       this.playAccumulator += dt
392:       if (this.playAccumulator >= 1) {
393:         this.state.stats.playTime = (this.state.stats.playTime || 0) + Math.floor(this.playAccumulator)
394:         this.playAccumulator -= Math.floor(this.playAccumulator)
395:       }
396:       this.renderer.updateCamera(this.world.player.x, this.world.player.y, dt)
397:       this.renderer.render(dt, {
398:         player: this.world.player,
399:         near: this.near,
400:         playerMoving: this.playerMoving,
401:         walkTime: this.walkTime,
402:       })
403:       this.hud?.update()
404:     }
405:     requestAnimationFrame(this.loop)
406:   }

408:   handleMovement(dt) {
409:     let dx = 0
410:     let dy = 0
411:     if (this.keys.has('up') || this.mobileKeys.has('up')) dy -= 1
412:     if (this.keys.has('down') || this.mobileKeys.has('down')) dy += 1
413:     if (this.keys.has('left') || this.mobileKeys.has('left')) dx -= 1
414:     if (this.keys.has('right') || this.mobileKeys.has('right')) dx += 1
415:     this.playerMoving = dx !== 0 || dy !== 0
416:     if (!this.playerMoving) return
417:     const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1
418:     const running = this.keys.has('shift')
419:     const speed = running ? 205 : 118
420:     this.world.movePlayer((dx / length) * speed * dt, (dy / length) * speed * dt)
421:     this.walkTime += dt * (running ? 1.55 : 1)
422:   }

424:   interact() {

426:     const near = this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()

439:         addItem(this.state, entity.item, count)

442:         break
443:       }
444:       case 'wild':
445:         this.startWildBattle(entity)
446:         break
447:       case 'boss':
448:         this.confirmGuardian(entity)
449:         break
450:       case 'mythic':

531:   completeBattle(battle, result) {
532:     if (!this.state || this.mode !== 'game') return
533:     const source = battle.source || {}
534:     const entity = source.entity
535: 
536:     if (result === 'win') {
537:       const rewards = battle.rewards || {}
538:       if (rewards.money) addMoney(this.state, rewards.money)
539:       if (rewards.trainerXp) addTrainerXp(this.state, rewards.trainerXp)
540:       for (const [id, count] of rewards.items || []) addItem(this.state, id, count)
541:       if (battle.trainer) {
542:         const id = battle.trainer.npcId || battle.trainer.id
543:         if (id) this.state.flags.trainers[id] = this.state.time.day
544:       }
545:       if (source.kind === 'boss' && entity) this.world.removeBoss(entity, false)
546:       else if (source.kind === 'mythic' && entity) this.world.removeMythic(entity, false)
547:       toast({
548:         title: battle.trainer ? 'Trainer defeated!' : source.kind === 'boss' ? 'Guardian calmed' : source.kind === 'mythic' ? 'Mythic overcome' : 'Battle won',
549:         text: `${rewards.money || 0} gold${rewards.trainerXp ? ` · ${rewards.trainerXp} trainer XP` : ''}`,
550:         icon: '✦', tone: 'success',
551:       })
552:     } else if (result === 'caught') {
553:       if (source.kind === 'boss' && entity) this.world.removeBoss(entity, true)
554:       else if (source.kind === 'mythic' && entity) this.world.removeMythic(entity, true)
555:       const caught = battle.caughtMonster

558:       }

562:       this.state.player.money = Math.max(0, this.state.player.money - lost)

564:       this.world.player.x = town.x * 16 + 8

568:       toast({ title: 'You were carried home', text: `Lost ${lost} gold. Your team is healed.`, icon: '✚', tone: 'warn' })
569:     }

571:     this.updatePlayerState()

728:   buildMobileControls() {
729:     const wrap = el('div', { class: 'mobile-controls' })

731:     const make = (dir, cls, glyph) => {
732:       const btn = el('button', { class: cls, 'aria-label': dir }, glyph)
733:       const press = e => {
734:         e.preventDefault()
735:         btn.classList.add('pressed')
736:         this.mobileKeys.add(dir)
737:         try { btn.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId) } catch {}
738:       }
739:       const release = e => {
740:         e?.preventDefault?.()
741:         btn.classList.remove('pressed')
742:         this.mobileKeys.delete(dir)
743:       }
744:       btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', press)
745:       btn.addEventListener('pointerup', release)
746:       btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', release)
747:       btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', release)
748:       return btn
749:     }
750:     dpad.append(
751:       make('up', 'dpad-up', '▲'),
752:       make('left', 'dpad-left', '◀'),
753:       make('right', 'dpad-right', '▶'),
754:       make('down', 'dpad-down', '▼'),
755:     )

757:     const actionPad = el('div', { class: 'action-pad' })
758:     this.actionBtn = el('button', { class: 'action-btn', 'aria-label': 'Interact' }, [
759:       el('span', { class: 'action-glyph' }, '✦'),
760:       el('span', { class: 'action-label' }, 'ACTION'),
761:     ])
762:     this.actionBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
763:       e.preventDefault()
764:       this.actionBtn.classList.add('pressed')
765:       this.interact()
766:     })
767:     const clear = () => this.actionBtn.classList.remove('pressed')
768:     this.actionBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', clear)
769:     this.actionBtn.addEventListener('pointercancel', clear)
770:     this.actionBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', clear)

659:     for (let y = 0; y <= 132; y += 22) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y * 5); ctx.lineTo(176 * 5, y * 5); ctx.stroke() }

704:     canvasWrap.append(canvas)

717:       ]),

  update() {
    const app = this.app
    const state = app.state
    if (!state) return
    const world = app.world
    const p = state.player
    const biome = BIOMES[world?.currentBiome] || BIOMES.forest
    const lead = state.party.find(m => !m.isEgg && m.hp > 0) || state.party.find(m => !m.isEgg)
    const night = isNight(state.time.minutes)

    // Trainer card (rebuild only when values change)
    const trainerKey = `${p.trainerLevel}|${p.money}|${p.trainerXp}`
    if (this.last.trainerKey !== trainerKey) {
      this.last.trainerKey = trainerKey
      this.trainer.innerHTML = ''
      const avatar = el('img', { class: 'trainer-avatar pixel-sprite', alt: 'trainer' })
      avatar.src = app.playerAvatarUrl()
      this.trainerRegion = el('div', { class: 'trainer-region' })
      this.trainerHpFill = el('div', { class: 'trainer-hp-fill' })
      this.trainerHp = el('div', { class: 'trainer-hp', title: 'Lead monster HP' }, [this.trainerHpFill])
      const info = el('div', { class: 'trainer-copy' }, [
        el('div', { class: 'trainer-line' }, [
          el('strong', {}, p.name),
          el('span', { class: 'trainer-lv' }, `Lv.${p.trainerLevel}`),
        ]),
        el('div', { class: 'trainer-title-line' }, trainerTitle(p.trainerLevel)),
        this.trainerRegion,
        this.trainerHp,
        el('div', { class: 'trainer-sub' }, [
          el('span', { class: 'money' }, `◈ ${p.money.toLocaleString()}`),
          el('span', { class: 'badges' }, `${Object.values(state.flags.bosses).filter(Boolean).length} / 8 guardians`),
        ]),
      ])
      this.trainer.append(avatar, info)
    }

    // Compact region + clock line, shown inside the trainer card on phones.
    const regionLineKey = `${biome.id}|${Math.floor(state.time.minutes / 5)}|${p.money}`
    if (this.trainerRegion && this.last.regionLineKey !== regionLineKey) {
      this.last.regionLineKey = regionLineKey
      this.trainerRegion.textContent = `${formatTime(state.time.minutes)} ${night ? '☾' : '·'} ${biome.name.split(' ')[0]}`
    }

    // Compact lead HP bar lives inside the trainer card on phones, so the old
    // floating monster dock can stay out of the play area.
    const leadHpPct = lead ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, lead.hp / maxHpOf(lead))) : 0
    const leadHpKey = lead ? `${lead.uid}:${lead.hp}:${maxHpOf(lead)}` : 'none'
    if (this.trainerHpFill && this.last.leadHpKey !== leadHpKey) {
      this.last.leadHpKey = leadHpKey
      this.trainerHpFill.style.width = `${leadHpPct * 100}%`
      this.trainerHpFill.className = `trainer-hp-fill ${leadHpPct > 0.5 ? '' : leadHpPct > 0.22 ? 'warn' : 'bad'}`
      this.trainerHp.title = lead ? `${lead.nickname} · ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(lead.hp))} / ${maxHpOf(lead)} HP` : 'No lead monster'
    }

    const regionKey = `${biome.id}|${night}`
    if (this.last.regionKey !== regionKey) {
      this.last.regionKey = regionKey
      this.region.innerHTML = ''
      this.region.append(
        el('span', { class: 'region-icon', style: { color: biome.hue } }, biome.icon),
        el('div', { class: 'region-copy' }, [
          el('strong', {}, biome.name),
          el('span', {}, `${timeOfDay(state.time.minutes)}${night ? ' · monsters stir' : ''}`),
        ]),
      )
    }

    const timeKey = `${Math.floor(state.time.minutes)}|${state.time.day}`
    if (this.last.timeKey !== timeKey) {
      this.last.timeKey = timeKey
      this.timeEl.innerHTML = ''
      this.timeEl.append(
        el('span', { class: 'clock-icon' }, night ? '☾' : '☀'),
        el('span', {}, formatTime(state.time.minutes)),

## Objective
- Improve the existing game, fix errors, and make mobile play clearer by removing the monster display that covers the play area.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.
- Save progress to Git regularly; the user asked to “save code on git every 15-20 later.”

## Decisions
- Hide the mobile party dock and keep lead-monster HP in the trainer card.
- Add a mobile sprint toggle, tap-outside-to-close dialogs, and 20-second in-game autosave.
- Treat autosave as game progress protection; recurring Git commits are not scheduled.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed the pause-menu Delete Save crash.
- Improved mobile HUD and touch controls; added sprint toggle and tap-outside dialog dismissal.
- Added autosaving during active exploration and saves on tab hide and before unload.
- Tested syntax, mobile movement and sprint, dialog dismissal, battle recovery, and a 20-second autosave.
- Committed and pushed all changes.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue with any new game improvements or bug reports.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: save behavior, autosave, mobile sprint and game input.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: lead-monster HP in trainer card.
- `src/ui/common.js`: tap-outside-to-close dialog behavior.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: pause menu and mobile controls help text.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: battle controls.
- `src/game/battle.js`: battle turn logic.
- `styles.css`: mobile HUD, party dock, controls, and battle layout.

## Important Context
- Latest commit: `b3be5b8` (`Improve mobile controls and autosave`), pushed to `origin/opencode/43550675728`.
- Working tree was clean after the push.

65:     const zoom = this.zoom
66:     const cam = this.camera
67:     const world = this.world
68:     const state = world.state
69: 
70:     ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#101a19'
72:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height)
73: 
74:     ctx.setTransform(dpr * zoom, 0, 0, dpr * zoom, -cam.x * dpr * zoom, -cam.y * dpr * zoom)
75:     ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false
76: 
77:     // Visible slice of baked ground
78:     const sx = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cam.x))
79:     const sy = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cam.y))
80:     const sw = Math.min(WORLD_W - sx, Math.ceil(this.viewW) + 2)
81:     const sh = Math.min(WORLD_H - sy, Math.ceil(this.viewH) + 2)
82:     if (sw > 0 && sh > 0) ctx.drawImage(world.mapCanvas, sx, sy, sw, sh, sx, sy, sw, sh)
83: 
84:     const decos = world.getDecosAround(cam.x, cam.y, this.viewW, this.viewH)
85:     const renderables = []
86:     for (const d of decos) {
87:       const x = d.x * TILE + 8, y = d.y * TILE + 16
88:       if (!this.isVisible(x, y, 80)) continue
89:       renderables.push({ y: y, type: 'deco', data: d, baseY: y })
90:     }
91:     for (const r of world.resources) {
92:       if (!r.available || !this.isVisible(r.x, r.y, 40)) continue
93:       renderables.push({ y: r.y, type: 'resource', data: r, baseY: r.y })
94:     }
95:     for (const n of world.npcs) {
96:       if (!this.isVisible(n.x, n.y, 60)) continue
97:       renderables.push({ y: n.y, type: 'npc', data: n, baseY: n.y })
98:     }
99:     for (const w of world.wilds) {
100:       if (!this.isVisible(w.x, w.y, 60)) continue
101:       renderables.push({ y: w.y, type: 'wild', data: w, baseY: w.y })
102:     }
103:     for (const b of world.bosses) {
104:       if (!this.isVisible(b.x, b.y, 90)) continue
105:       renderables.push({ y: b.y, type: 'boss', data: b, baseY: b.y })
106:     }
107:     for (const m of world.mythics) {
108:       if (!this.isVisible(m.x, m.y, 90)) continue
109:       renderables.push({ y: m.y, type: 'mythic', data: m, baseY: m.y })
110:     }
111:     const moving = playerMoving
112:     const frame = Math.floor(walkTime * 6) % 2
113:     renderables.push({ y: player.y, type: 'player', data: { ...player, frame: moving ? frame : 0 }, baseY: player.y })
114: 
115:     renderables.sort((a, b) => a.baseY - b.baseY)
116: 
117:     // Auras behind bosses
118:     for (const b of [...world.bosses, ...world.mythics]) {
119:       if (!this.isVisible(b.x, b.y, 90)) continue
120:       this.drawAura(ctx, b.x, b.y - 16, b.kind === 'mythic' ? '#ffe27a' : '#ff8a4c', b.kind === 'mythic' ? 46 : 34)
121:     }
122: 
123:     for (const item of renderables) {
124:       switch (item.type) {
125:         case 'deco': this.drawDeco(ctx, item.data); break
126:         case 'resource': this.drawResource(ctx, item.data); break
127:         case 'npc': this.drawNpc(ctx, item.data, near); break
128:         case 'wild': this.drawWild(ctx, item.data); break
129:         case 'boss': this.drawWild(ctx, item.data, true); break
130:         case 'mythic': this.drawWild(ctx, item.data, true); break
131:         case 'player': this.drawPlayer(ctx, item.data, near); break
132:       }
133:     }
134: 
135:     // ground-level labels for towns
136:     this.drawTownLabels(ctx)
137: 
138:     // screen-space layers
139:     ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
140:     this.drawWeather(ctx, state, dt)
141:     this.drawLighting(ctx, state, player)
142:     this.drawPrompts(ctx, near, player)
143:     this.drawClockHalo(ctx, state)
144:   }

146:   // ── entity drawing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
147:   drawShadow(ctx, x, y, w = 12, h = 4) {
148:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)'
149:     ctx.beginPath()
150:     ctx.ellipse(x, y, w / 2, h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
151:     ctx.fill()
152:   }
153: 
154:   drawPlayer(ctx, p, near) {
155:     this.drawShadow(ctx, p.x, p.y + 1, 14, 5)
156:     const sprite = playerSprite(p.dir, p.frame)
157:     ctx.drawImage(sprite, Math.round(p.x - 9), Math.round(p.y - 24 + (p.frame ? -1 : 0)), 18, 26)
158:     if (near && near.kind === 'npc' && Math.hypot(near.entity.x - p.x, near.entity.y - p.y) < 34) {
159:       // little exclamation over the player's head
160:       this.drawBubble(ctx, p.x, p.y - 40, '!')
161:     }
162:   }
163: 
164:   drawNpc(ctx, n, near) {
165:     this.drawShadow(ctx, n.x, n.y + 10, 14, 5)
166:     const sprite = npcSprite(n.look || n.role, n.dir || 'down', 0)
167:     ctx.drawImage(sprite, Math.round(n.x - 9), Math.round(n.y - 14), 18, 26)
168:     // role badge
169:     ctx.font = 'bold 7px monospace'
170:     ctx.textAlign = 'center'
171:     const glyph = n.role === 'healer' ? '✚' : n.role === 'shop' ? '◈' : n.role === 'quest' ? '!' : n.role === 'trainer' ? '⚔' : n.role === 'nursery' ? '◈' : ''
172:     if (glyph) {
173:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,18,0.75)'
174:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(n.x - 5, n.y - 34, 10, 10, 3); ctx.fill()
175:       ctx.fillStyle = n.role === 'healer' ? '#8ee08a' : n.role === 'trainer' ? '#ff9a9a' : n.role === 'quest' ? '#ffd36e' : '#e3b96b'
176:       ctx.fillText(glyph, n.x, n.y - 26)
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   drawWild(ctx, w, big = false) {
181:     const t = this.time * 2 + (w.bob || 0)
182:     const bob = Math.sin(t) * (big ? 2 : 1.4)
183:     const scale = big ? 2.05 : 1.15
184:     const sprite = monsterSprite(w.speciesId)
185:     const flip = w.dir === 'left'
186:     const drawSprite = flip ? this.flipped(sprite) : sprite
187:     const wSize = 40 * scale, hSize = 40 * scale
188:     const baseX = w.x - wSize / 2
189:     const baseY = w.y + 8 - hSize + bob
190:     this.drawShadow(ctx, w.x, w.y + 7, big ? 34 : 20, big ? 9 : 6)
191:     if (big) {
192:       ctx.save()
193:       const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(this.time * 3 + (w.bob || 0)) * 0.2
194:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35
195:       ctx.fillStyle = w.kind === 'mythic' ? '#ffe27a' : '#ff8a4c'
196:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(w.x, w.y + 4, 26 + pulse * 6, 10 + pulse * 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
197:       ctx.restore()
198:     }
199:     ctx.drawImage(drawSprite, Math.round(baseX), Math.round(baseY), wSize, hSize)
200:     if (big) {
201:       const sp = getMonster(w.speciesId)
202:       ctx.textAlign = 'center'
203:       ctx.font = 'bold 6px monospace'
204:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,16,0.75)'
205:       const width = Math.max(46, sp.name.length * 5 + 14)
206:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(w.x - width / 2, w.y - 62, width, 10, 3); ctx.fill()
207:       ctx.fillStyle = w.kind === 'mythic' ? '#ffe27a' : '#ffc2a1'
208:       ctx.fillText(`${sp.name} Lv.${w.monster.level}`, w.x, w.y - 54)
209:     }
210:     if (w.kind === 'wild' && this.nearWild === w.id) this.drawBubble(ctx, w.x, w.y - 34, '!')
211:   }

213:   flipped(canvas) {
214:     if (!canvas._flipped) canvas._flipped = flipCanvas(canvas)
215:     return canvas._flipped
216:   }

218:   drawBubble(ctx, x, y, glyph) {
219:     const bob = Math.sin(this.time * 4) * 2
220:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,18,26,0.85)'
221:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(x - 7, y - 8 + bob, 14, 13, 4); ctx.fill()
222:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,226,122,0.8)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke()
223:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe27a'
224:     ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace'
225:     ctx.textAlign = 'center'
226:     ctx.fillText(glyph, x, y + 2 + bob)
227:   }

229:   drawResource(ctx, r) {
230:     const bob = Math.sin(this.time * 2.4 + r.tx) * 1.2
231:     const glow = r.item === 'stardust' || r.item === 'crystal_shard'
232:     ctx.save()
233:     ctx.translate(r.x, r.y - 4 + bob)
234:     if (glow) {
235:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25
236:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8'
237:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
238:       ctx.globalAlpha = 1
239:     }
240:     // small plant / crystal node
241:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'
242:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 6, 7, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
243:     const colors = {
244:       herb: ['#3f7a48', '#8fe07a'], spring_water: ['#3f86a8', '#b8ecff'], dusk_flower: ['#4a2a68', '#d8b8ff'],
245:       ember_shard: ['#6b2e22', '#ffb066'], ice_shard: ['#28617f', '#c9f8ff'], crystal_shard: ['#5a4a8a', '#e0c8ff'],
246:       sun_bloom: ['#7a5c1a', '#ffe27a'], spore_cap: ['#4a2a68', '#b48ae0'], relic_fragment: ['#5e604e', '#e3d6b8'],
247:       iron_ore: ['#4e5964', '#b8c4d0'], scrap_metal: ['#4e5964', '#c8d0d8'], stardust: ['#7a6418', '#fff3a8'],
248:       crystal: ['#5a4a8a', '#e0c8ff'],
249:     }
250:     const [dark, light] = colors[r.item] || ['#3f7a48', '#8fe07a']
251:     ctx.strokeStyle = dark; ctx.fillStyle = light; ctx.lineWidth = 2
252:     if (r.item.includes('crystal') || r.item === 'ice_shard' || r.item === 'ember_shard' || r.item === 'stardust') {
253:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -10); ctx.lineTo(5, -2); ctx.lineTo(2, 5); ctx.lineTo(-3, 5); ctx.lineTo(-5, -2); ctx.closePath()
254:       ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
255:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(-1, -7, 1, 4)
256:     } else if (r.item === 'herb' || r.item === 'dusk_flower' || r.item === 'sun_bloom' || r.item === 'spore_cap') {
257:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
258:       ctx.fillStyle = dark; ctx.fillRect(-1, 2, 2, 6)
259:       if (r.item === 'spore_cap') { ctx.fillStyle = light; ctx.fillRect(-4, -1, 8, 2) }
260:     } else {
261:       ctx.fillRect(-5, -4, 10, 9)
262:       ctx.strokeStyle = dark; ctx.strokeRect(-5, -4, 10, 9)
263:       ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d8b0'; ctx.fillRect(-2, -1, 2, 2)
264:     }
265:     ctx.restore()
266:     if (this.time * 2 % 2 > 1.2) {
267:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,240,180,0.8)'
268:       ctx.fillRect(r.x + 4, r.y - 16, 2, 2)
269:     }
270:   }

272:   drawAura(ctx, x, y, color, radius) {
273:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, radius)
274:     grad.addColorStop(0, color + '66')
275:     grad.addColorStop(0.6, color + '22')
276:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
277:     ctx.save()
278:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
279:     ctx.fillStyle = grad
280:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
281:     ctx.restore()
282:   }

284:   // ── decorations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
285:   drawDeco(ctx, d) {
286:     const x = d.x * TILE + 8
287:     const y = d.y * TILE + 16
288:     const pal = BIOMES[d.biome]?.palette || BIOMES.forest.palette
289:     const v = d.variant || 0
290:     const r = (dx, dy, w, h, color) => { ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillRect(x + dx, y + dy, w, h) }
291:     const circle = (cx, cy, rad, color) => {
292:       ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + cx, y + cy, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
293:     }
294:     const tri = (pts, color) => {
295:       ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + pts[0], y + pts[1])
296:       for (let i = 2; i < pts.length; i += 2) ctx.lineTo(x + pts[i], y + pts[i + 1])
297:       ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
298:     }
299:     const shadow = (w = 18) => { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + 1, w / 2, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill() }
300: 
301:     switch (d.type) {
302:       case 'tree': {
303:         shadow(22)
304:         r(-3, -10, 6, 12, '#4a3324')
305:         r(-2, -10, 2, 12, '#6b4a30')
306:         circle(0, -24, 13, '#204a2c')
307:         circle(-5, -28, 9, '#2f6b3d')
308:         circle(5, -27, 8, '#2f6b3d')
309:         circle(-2, -32, 8, pal.ground3)
310:         circle(4, -21, 7, '#3f7a48')
311:         if (v === 1) { circle(-8, -20, 4, '#8fe07a') }
312:         if (v === 3) { circle(7, -33, 3, '#ffe27a') }
313:         break
314:       }
315:       case 'deadTree': {
316:         shadow(16)
317:         r(-2, -24, 4, 26, '#3a2d2a')
318:         r(-2, -18, 10, 3, '#3a2d2a')
319:         r(-9, -22, 7, 2, '#3a2d2a')
320:         r(-8, -26, 2, 5, '#3a2d2a')
321:         r(6, -25, 2, 8, '#3a2d2a')
322:         r(-11, -29, 2, 8, '#3a2d2a')
323:         circle(-10, -30, 2, pal.accent)
324:         break
325:       }
326:       case 'pine': {
327:         shadow(18)
328:         r(-2, -8, 4, 9, '#4a3324')
329:         tri([0, -38, -11, -16, 11, -16], '#1e4a3a')
330:         tri([0, -31, -9, -10, 9, -10], '#2b5e48')
331:         tri([0, -36, -5, -20, 5, -20], '#d8eef5')
332:         break
333:       }
334:       case 'bush': {
335:         circle(-4, -5, 6, '#2f6b3d'); circle(4, -5, 6, '#3f7a48'); circle(0, -8, 7, '#4b8a52')
336:         if (v % 2) circle(2, -10, 2, '#ffd36e')
337:         break
338:       }
339:       case 'flowers': {
340:         for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
341:           const ox = (i * 5 + v * 3) % 12 - 6
342:           r(ox, -3, 1, 4, '#3f7a48')
343:           circle(ox, -4, 1.8, i % 2 ? '#ffd36e' : '#ff9fb8')
344:         }
345:         break
346:       }
347:       case 'fern': {
348:         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
349:           const a = -2 + i
350:           ctx.strokeStyle = '#6fce74'; ctx.lineWidth = 1
351:           ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + a * 4, y - 8, x + a * 5, y - 12); ctx.stroke()
352:         }
353:         break
354:       }
355:       case 'stump': {
356:         shadow(12); r(-5, -6, 10, 7, '#5a3f2a'); circle(0, -6, 5, '#8a6844'); circle(0, -6, 2, '#6b4a30')

358:       }
359:       case 'cactus': {
360:         shadow(12); r(-3, -18, 6, 19, '#3f7a48'); r(-8, -12, 4, 4, '#3f7a48'); r(-8, -6, 4, 8, '#3f7a48')
361:         r(4, -9, 4, 5, '#3f7a48'); r(4, -4, 4, 7, '#3f7a48')
362:         r(-2, -16, 1, 14, '#6fce74'); r(-9, -14, 1, 5, '#6fce74')
363:         if (v % 2) circle(0, -20, 2, '#ffd36e')
364:         break
365:       }
366:       case 'crystal': {
367:         shadow(16)
368:         tri([-5, 0, -2, -24, 2, 0], '#8a6ad8'); tri([-2, 0, 3, -30, 7, 0], '#b48ae0'); tri([5, 0, 8, -16, 11, 0], '#d8c0ff')
369:         tri([0, -2, 2, -20, 5, -2], '#e8d8ff')
370:         ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3; circle(3, -14, 12, '#c9b3ff'); ctx.globalAlpha = 1
371:         break

373:       case 'rock': {
374:         shadow(16); circle(-4, -5, 7, '#5e604e'); circle(4, -6, 6, '#6e705c'); circle(0, -9, 4, '#8a8c76')

376:       }
377:       case 'iceRock': {

379:         r(-3, -12, 2, 3, '#f4ffff')

382:       case 'obsidian': {

384:         r(-1, -16, 1, 6, '#ff8a4c')

389:         break

392:         shadow(12); circle(0, -1, 6, '#3b2a26'); circle(0, -2, 4, '#ff8a4c')
393:         ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35; circle(2, -14 + Math.sin(this.time + v) * 2, 5, '#ffd8b0'); ctx.globalAlpha = 1
394:         break

396:       case 'forge': {
397:         shadow(24); r(-10, -16, 20, 16, '#4b3b3a'); r(-8, -18, 16, 3, '#6d5347')
398:         r(-3, -12, 6, 8, '#ff8a4c'); r(-2, -10, 4, 5, '#ffd36e')

402:       case 'pillar': {
403:         shadow(18); r(-6, -26, 12, 27, '#8a8570'); r(-7, -28, 14, 4, '#b0aa92'); r(-7, -2, 14, 4, '#6e705c')
404:         r(-4, -24, 2, 22, '#b8b29a'); if (v % 2) r(-1, -18, 2, 6, '#5e604e')

411:       case 'urn': {
412:         shadow(10); ctx.fillStyle = '#a87f5a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y - 6, 5, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
413:         r(-3, -14, 6, 2, '#8a5f3a')
414:         break

416:       case 'stairs': {
417:         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) r(-8 + i * 2, -3 - i * 5, 16 - i * 4, 4, i % 2 ? '#8a8570' : '#a8a38a')

420:       case 'gear': {
421:         shadow(10); circle(0, -5, 7, '#6b7078'); circle(0, -5, 3, '#3d4248')
422:         for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) { r(-1 + Math.cos(a) * 8, -6 + Math.sin(a) * 8, 2, 2, '#8a9098') }
423:         break
424:       }
425:       case 'bone': {
426:         shadow(14); r(-8, -4, 12, 2, '#d8d0b8'); r(-8, -1, 12, 2, '#c8c0a8'); circle(-9, -3, 2, '#e8e0c8'); circle(5, -3, 2, '#e8e0c8')
427:         break

431:         break

433:       case 'nest': {
434:         shadow(20); ctx.strokeStyle = '#7a5a3a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2
435:         ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y - 3, 10, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke()
436:         circle(0, -5, 4, '#e8e0c8'); circle(3, -6, 3, '#d8d0b8')

439:       case 'spring': {
440:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,220,230,0.55)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y - 2, 10, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
441:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(220,255,255,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(x - 5, y - 3, 4, 1)
442:         break
443:       }
444:       case 'banner': {
445:         shadow(8); r(-1, -30, 2, 31, '#4a3324'); r(1, -29, 12, 12, '#8a2f3a')
446:         r(3, -26, 6, 4, '#ffd36e'); r(1, -18, 12, 2, '#6b222a')
447:         break
448:       }
449:       case 'mushroom': {
450:         shadow(8); r(-1, -7, 3, 7, '#d8d0b8'); circle(1, -8, 6, '#5b3a7e'); circle(0, -9, 4, '#b48ae0')
451:         if (v % 2) circle(-2, -10, 1, '#ffe27a')
452:         break
453:       }

## Objective
- Improve the existing game and address reported gameplay and mobile usability issues.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.
- Save progress to Git regularly; the user asked to “save code on git every 15-20 later.”
- New request: “Add more monster in wild and make the 2px*2px only in the garden expect for boss”.

## Decisions
- Hide the mobile party dock and keep lead-monster HP in the trainer card.
- Add a mobile sprint toggle, tap-outside-to-close dialogs, and 20-second in-game autosave.
- Treat autosave as game progress protection; recurring Git commits are not scheduled.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed the pause-menu Delete Save crash.
- Improved mobile HUD and touch controls; added sprint toggle and tap-outside dialog dismissal.
- Added autosaving during active exploration and saves on tab hide and before unload.
- Tested syntax, mobile movement and sprint, dialog dismissal, battle recovery, and a 20-second autosave.
- Committed and pushed all changes.

### Active
- Investigate and implement increased wild monster encounters and restrict “2px*2px” to the garden, excluding bosses; the exact meaning of “2px*2px” remains unclear from the available history.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect wild encounter/spawn and garden rendering or sizing logic to determine where to increase wild monsters and apply the requested garden-only sizing rule, while preserving boss behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/world.js`: likely world and wild encounter generation.
- `src/render/worldRenderer.js`: renders wild monsters and bosses.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: procedural monster sprite rendering.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: biome definitions, potentially including the garden.

## Important Context
- Latest known commit: `b3be5b8` (`Improve mobile controls and autosave`), pushed to `origin/opencode/43550675728`; working tree was clean after that push.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing game and address gameplay and mobile usability issues.
- Increase wild monster encounters and apply the requested “2px*2px only in the garden expect for boss” rule.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.
- Save progress to Git regularly; the user asked to “save code on git every 15-20 later.”
- “Add more monster in wild and make the 2px*2px only in the garden expect for boss”.

## Decisions
- Hide the mobile party dock and keep lead-monster HP in the trainer card.
- Add a mobile sprint toggle, tap-outside-to-close dialogs, and 20-second in-game autosave.
- Treat autosave as game progress protection; recurring Git commits are not scheduled.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed the pause-menu Delete Save crash.
- Improved mobile HUD and touch controls; added sprint toggle and tap-outside dialog dismissal.
- Added autosaving during active exploration and saves on tab hide and before unload.
- Tested syntax, mobile movement and sprint, dialog dismissal, battle recovery, and a 20-second autosave.
- Committed and pushed these changes; latest known commit is `b3be5b8` (`Improve mobile controls and autosave`).
- Inspected wild-spawn and world-rendering code; no implementation changes made for the latest request.

### Active
- Increase wild monster counts and determine/apply the intended “2px*2px” garden-only sizing rule, while preserving boss behavior.

### Blocked
- The meaning of “2px*2px” and which area “the garden” refers to are unclear; the codebase search found no matching size rule or garden biome.

## Next Move
1. Inspect relevant spawn and rendering logic to choose a reasonable increase to wild encounters.
2. Resolve the “2px*2px” ambiguity from existing game context, then implement the garden-only rule while excluding bosses.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/world.js`: initial and ongoing wild spawn counts and spawn positions.
- `src/render/worldRenderer.js`: wild and boss sprite display sizing.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: procedural monster sprite source dimensions and pixel-art rendering.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: biome definitions; none is named “garden”.

## Important Context
- `spawnAll()` creates three wilds per biome; `updateSpawns()` replenishes to three.
- `drawWild()` renders regular monsters at `1.15` scale and bosses/mythics at `2.05`.
- World camera zoom is `2` on mobile and `3` otherwise; this is not a monster-size rule.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e27c58d7bffeUGAaQONwLu7gpD" state="completed">
## Findings and recommended fixes

1. **Healing items can appear to fail or be wasted**
   - In [`src/game/inventory.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/game/inventory.js), field-item use validates whether an item can be used, but the item picker in [`src/ui/screens.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/ui/screens.js) closes before showing a failure toast. That can make an invalid use look like a silent failure. The item is not consumed.
   - In battle, [`src/game/battle.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/game/battle.js) rejects invalid item use, but the rejection can still allow the enemy to act. `takeTurn()` increments the turn before the action is validated.
   - **Recommendation:** Filter or disable unusable items in the picker, make the reason for rejection visible without closing the picker, and validate battle items before advancing the turn. Rejected actions should not consume a turn.

2. **Damage appears before the skill animation finishes**
   - Battle state is mutated before playback. In [`src/ui/battleUI.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/ui/battleUI.js), `play()` calls `sync()` during event playback, so the UI can display resolved HP while the move animation is still running.
   - **Recommendation:** Keep the displayed HP separate from resolved battle state during playback. Apply or reveal the HP change after the attack animation, then sync the UI.

3. **Trainer card shows monster HP instead of player EXP**
   - The mobile trainer card in [`src/ui/hud.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/ui/hud.js) currently uses the lead monster’s HP for its bar.
   - [`src/game/state.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/game/state.js) already provides `trainerProgress()`, including current XP, XP needed, and progress percentage. The pause menu in [`src/ui/screens.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/ui/screens.js) uses trainer XP.
   - **Recommendation:** Use `trainerProgress()` for the trainer card’s XP text and progress bar instead of lead-monster HP.

4. **Wild encounters can favor low-level monsters**
   - [`src/game/world.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/game/world.js) selects nearby wild monsters through `closestWild(radius)` without filtering by biome. Wild monsters can drift, and the homeward behavior only activates beyond 90 pixels, so a nearby monster from another area can be selected.
   - Biome level ranges are defined in [`src/data/biomes.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/data/biomes.js).
   - **Recommendation:** Filter encounter candidates by the player’s current biome, keep wild movement within biome boundaries, and review biome level ranges for progression balance.

5. **Battle buttons can seem intermittent, especially on mobile**
   - In [`src/ui/battleUI.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/ui/battleUI.js), actions are silently ignored while playback is busy, but the buttons lack a corresponding disabled/busy state.
   - Mobile directional controls in [`src/app.js`](/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/app.js) remove held input on pointer leave, which can interrupt input if a touch moves off the control.
   - **Recommendation:** Visibly disable or mark battle controls busy during playback, and make mobile pointer handling resilient to a touch drifting outside a control.

**No files were edited.**

156:       if (side === 'player' && this.active.hp <= 0) continue
157:       if (side === 'enemy' && this.enemy.hp <= 0) continue
158:       if (side === 'player') this.useMove('player', index)
159:       else this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
160:       const faints = this.checkFaints()
161:       if (faints.enemyFainted || faints.playerFainted) break
162:     }
163:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
164:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
165:   }

193:   doCaptureTurn(action) {
194:     const item = getItem(action.itemId)
195:     if (!this.canCapture) { this.log('You cannot capture another trainer\'s monster!'); return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true } }
196:     if (item.type !== 'orb') return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true }
197:     if ((this.state.inventory[action.itemId] || 0) <= 0) { this.log(`You are out of ${item.name}.`); return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true } }
198:     // consume

201:     const chance = this.captureChance(action.itemId)
202:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-throw', itemId: action.itemId, chance, speciesId: this.enemy.speciesId })
203:     this.log(`You threw a ${item.name}!`)
204:     const roll = Math.random()
205:     const shakes = roll < chance ? 3 : roll < chance * 1.8 ? 2 : roll < chance * 2.8 ? 1 : 0
206:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-shake', shakes, chance })
207:     if (roll < chance) {
208:       this.log(`${getMonster(this.enemy.speciesId).name} was caught!`)
209:       const caught = this.enemy
210:       caught.status = null
211:       caught.statusTurns = 0
212:       caught.caughtAt = Date.now()
213:       caught.caughtBiome = this.biome
214:       caught.caughtNight = isNight(this.state.time.minutes)
215:       recordCatch(this.state, caught, { night: caught.caughtNight })
216:       const toParty = addMonster(this.state, caught)
217:       this.caughtMonster = caught
218:       this.rewards.money = 0
219:       this.events.push({ type: 'captured', monster: caught, toParty, speciesId: caught.speciesId })
220:       this.result = 'caught'
221:       this.over = true
222:       this.state.stats.battles++
223:       return this.finishTurnEvents()
224:     }
225:     this.log('Oh no! The monster broke free!')
226:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-fail' })
227:     const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
228:     if (!this.over) this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
229:     this.checkFaints()
230:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
231:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
232:   }

259:   useBattleItem(itemId, targetIndex) {
260:     const item = getItem(itemId)
261:     if ((this.state.inventory[itemId] || 0) <= 0) { this.log(`You have no ${item.name} left.`); return null }
262:     const target = this.playerParty[targetIndex ?? this.activeIndex]
263:     if (!target) return null
264:     if (item.type === 'orb') { this.log('Use the Capture action to throw an orb.'); return null }
265:     if (item.escape) {
266:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
267:       if (this.state.inventory[itemId] <= 0) delete this.state.inventory[itemId]
268:       if (!this.canEscape) { this.log('The rope fizzles. This battle cannot be escaped!'); return null }
269:       this.log('You used an Escape Rope!')
270:       this.result = 'escaped'; this.over = true; this.state.stats.battles++
271:       this.events.push({ type: 'escaped' })
272:       return { fled: true }
273:     }
274:     if (item.type === 'potion') {
275:       if (target.hp <= 0) { this.log(`${target.nickname} has fainted. Use a Revive Shard.`); return null }
276:       if (target.hp >= maxHpOf(target) && !item.cure) { this.log(`${target.nickname} is already at full HP.`); return null }
277:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
278:       if (this.state.inventory[itemId] <= 0) delete this.state.inventory[itemId]
279:       const max = maxHpOf(target)
280:       const before = target.hp
281:       target.hp = item.heal === 'full' ? max : Math.min(max, target.hp + item.heal)
282:       if (item.cure) target.status = null
283:       this.log(`You used ${item.name} on ${target.nickname}.`)
284:       this.events.push({ type: 'heal-item', side: target === this.active ? 'player' : 'bench', targetUid: target.uid, amount: target.hp - before, hp: target.hp, maxHp: max })
285:       return { ok: true }
286:     }
287:     if (item.type === 'cure') {
288:       if (!target.status) { this.log('It has no effect.'); return null }
289:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
290:       target.status = null
291:       this.log(`${target.nickname} was cured of ${item.cure.join(', ')}.`)
292:       this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side: 'player', targetUid: target.uid })
293:       return { ok: true }
294:     }
295:     if (item.type === 'battle' && item.energy) {
296:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
297:       this.energy.player.set(target.uid, clamp((this.energy.player.get(target.uid) ?? 100) + item.energy, 0, 100))
298:       this.log(`${target.nickname} recovered energy!`)
299:       this.events.push({ type: 'energy', side: 'player', value: this.energy.player.get(target.uid) })
300:       return { ok: true }
301:     }
302:     if (item.type === 'revive') {
303:       if (target.hp > 0) { this.log('That monster has not fainted.'); return null }
304:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
305:       target.hp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxHpOf(target) * item.revive))
306:       this.log(`${target.nickname} was revived!`)
307:       this.events.push({ type: 'revive', targetUid: target.uid, hp: target.hp, maxHp: maxHpOf(target) })
308:       return { ok: true }
309:     }
310:     this.log('That item cannot be used in battle.')
311:     return null
312:   }

314:   // ── move use ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
315:   useMove(side, moveIndex) {
316:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
317:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
318:     const skill = getSkill(attacker.moves[moveIndex] || attacker.moves[0] || 'tackle')
319:     const attackerLabel = side === 'player' ? attacker.nickname : `${getMonster(attacker.speciesId).name}`
320:     if (attacker.hp <= 0) return
321: 
322:     // status check
323:     if (this.statusPreventsAction(side)) return
324: 
325:     // energy
326:     const energy = side === 'player' ? this.activeEnergy : this.enemyEnergy
327:     let usedSkill = skill
328:     if (skill.cost > energy) {
329:       usedSkill = getSkill('tackle')
330:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} is low on energy and uses Tackle!`)
331:     } else {
332:       if (side === 'player') this.activeEnergy = energy - skill.cost
333:       else this.enemyEnergy = energy - skill.cost
334:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} used ${skill.name}!`)
335:     }
336:     this.events.push({
337:       type: 'move', side, moveId: usedSkill.id, moveName: usedSkill.name,
338:       element: usedSkill.element, energy: side === 'player' ? this.activeEnergy : this.enemyEnergy,
339:     })
340: 
341:     // status moves
342:     if (usedSkill.category === 'status') {
343:       const accStage = this.stageOf(side, 'acc')
344:       const accuracy = clamp((usedSkill.accuracy || 100) * stageMultiplier(accStage) / 100, 0.05, 1)
345:       if (Math.random() > accuracy) {
346:         this.log(`${defender.nickname} avoided the attack!`)
347:         this.events.push({ type: 'miss', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
348:         return
349:       }
350:       this.applySkillEffect(side, usedSkill, true)
351:       return
352:     }
353: 
354:     // accuracy
355:     const accStage = this.stageOf(side, 'acc')
356:     const accuracy = clamp((usedSkill.accuracy || 100) * stageMultiplier(accStage) / 100, 0.05, 1)
357:     if (Math.random() > accuracy) {
358:       this.log(`${defender.nickname} avoided the attack!`)
359:       this.events.push({ type: 'miss', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
360:       return
361:     }
362: 
363:     const hits = usedSkill.multi || 1
364:     for (let i = 0; i < hits; i++) {
365:       const res = this.calculateDamage(side, usedSkill)
366:       if (res.immune) {
367:         this.log(`${getMonster(defender.speciesId).name} is immune to ${usedSkill.element} attacks!`)
368:         this.events.push({ type: 'immune', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
369:         return
370:       }
371:       defender.hp = Math.max(0, defender.hp - res.damage)
372:       const effLabel = effectivenessLabel(res.effectiveness)
373:       this.events.push({
374:         type: 'damage', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player',
375:         amount: res.damage, crit: res.crit, effectiveness: res.effectiveness,
376:         hp: defender.hp, maxHp: maxHpOf(defender), element: usedSkill.element,
377:         effLabel: effLabel?.text || null,
378:       })
379:       if (res.crit) this.log('A critical hit!')
380:       if (effLabel) this.log(effLabel.text)
381:       if (usedSkill.drain && res.damage > 0) {
382:         const heal = Math.max(1, Math.floor(res.damage * usedSkill.drain))
383:         attacker.hp = Math.min(maxHpOf(attacker), attacker.hp + heal)
384:         this.log(`${attackerLabel} drained ${heal} HP!`)
385:       }
386:       if (defender.hp <= 0) break
387:     }
388: 
389:     // secondary effects
390:     this.applySkillEffect(side, usedSkill, false)
391: 
392:     // recoil
393:     if (usedSkill.recoil && attacker.hp > 0) {
394:       const recoil = Math.max(1, Math.floor(attacker.hp * usedSkill.recoil))
395:       attacker.hp = Math.max(0, attacker.hp - recoil)
396:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} is hurt by recoil!`)
397:     }
398: 
399:     // contact passive
400:     if (usedSkill.category === 'physical' && defender.hp > 0 && attacker.hp > 0) {
401:       const defSp = getMonster(defender.speciesId)
402:       const passive = getPassive(defSp.passive)
403:       if (passive.kind === 'contactStatus' && !attacker.status && Math.random() * 100 < passive.chance) {
404:         this.applyStatus(side, passive.status)
405:       }
406:     }
407:   }
408: 
409:   applySkillEffect(side, skill, isStatusMove) {
410:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
411:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
412:     const foeSide = side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player'
413:     // stat changes
414:     if (skill.stat) {
415:       const effects = Array.isArray(skill.stat) ? skill.stat : [skill.stat]
416:       for (const eff of effects) {
417:         const targetSide = eff.target === 'self' ? side : foeSide
418:         this.applyStage(targetSide, eff.stat, eff.stages)
419:         const who = targetSide === 'player' ? this.active.nickname : getMonster(this.enemy.speciesId).name
420:         this.log(`${who}'s ${eff.stat.toUpperCase()} ${stageName(eff.stages)}!`)
421:         this.events.push({ type: 'stage', side: targetSide, stat: eff.stat, stages: this.stageOf(targetSide, eff.stat) })
422:       }
423:     }
424:     if (skill.heal) {
425:       const max = maxHpOf(attacker)
426:       const heal = Math.floor(max * skill.heal)
427:       attacker.hp = Math.min(max, attacker.hp + heal)
428:       if (skill.cure) attacker.status = null
429:       this.log(`${attacker.nickname} restored ${heal} HP!`)
430:       this.events.push({ type: 'heal', side, amount: heal, hp: attacker.hp, maxHp: max })
431:       if (skill.partyHeal) {
432:         for (const m of this.playerParty) {
433:           if (m.uid === attacker.uid || m.hp <= 0) continue
434:           m.hp = Math.min(maxHpOf(m), m.hp + Math.floor(maxHpOf(m) * skill.heal))
435:         }
436:       }
437:     }
438:     if (skill.selfStatus) {
439:       this.applyStatus(side, skill.selfStatus)
440:     }
441:     if (skill.seed) {
442:       this.seeded[foeSide] = true
443:       this.log(`${getMonster(defender.speciesId).name} was seeded!`)
444:       this.events.push({ type: 'seed', side: foeSide })
445:     }
446:     if (skill.status && skill.status.chance > 0) {
447:       if (isStatusMove || Math.random() * 100 < skill.status.chance) {
448:         if (defender.hp > 0 && !defender.status) this.applyStatus(foeSide, skill.status.id)
449:       }
450:     }
451:   }
452: 
453:   applyStatus(side, statusId) {
454:     const target = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
455:     if (target.status) return false
456:     if (side === 'player' && statusId === 'burn' && target.speciesId && getMonster(target.speciesId).element === 'flame') return false
457:     target.status = statusId
458:     target.statusTurns = statusId === 'sleep' ? 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) : statusId === 'freeze' ? 2 : 99
459:     this.log(`${target.nickname} is ${statusId === 'paralysis' ? 'paralyzed' : statusId === 'burn' ? 'burned' : statusId === 'freeze' ? 'frozen' : statusId === 'sleep' ? 'asleep' : 'poisoned'}!`)
460:     this.events.push({ type: 'status', side, status: statusId, label: statusName(statusId) })
461:     return true
462:   }
463: 
464:   statusPreventsAction(side) {
465:     const m = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
466:     if (!m.status) return false
467:     if (m.status === 'sleep') {
468:       m.statusTurns--
469:       if (m.statusTurns <= 0) {
470:         m.status = null
471:         this.log(`${m.nickname} woke up!`)
472:         this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side })
473:         return false
474:       }
475:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is fast asleep.`)
476:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'sleep' })
477:       return true
478:     }
479:     if (m.status === 'freeze') {
480:       if (Math.random() < 0.35 || m.statusTurns-- <= 0) {
481:         m.status = null
482:         this.log(`${m.nickname} thawed out!`)
483:         this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side })
484:         return false
485:       }
486:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is frozen solid!`)
487:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'freeze' })
488:       return true
489:     }
490:     if (m.status === 'paralysis' && Math.random() < 0.25) {
491:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is paralyzed and cannot move!`)
492:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'paralysis' })
493:       return true
494:     }
495:     return false
496:   }
497: 
498:   calculateDamage(side, skill) {
499:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
500:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
501:     const defenderSp = getMonster(defender.speciesId)
502:     const defenderPassive = getPassive(defenderSp.passive)
503:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'immuneElement' && defenderPassive.element === skill.element) {
504:       return { damage: 0, effectiveness: 1, crit: false, immune: true }
505:     }
506:     const atkStat = skill.category === 'physical' ? 'atk' : 'spa'
507:     const defStat = skill.category === 'physical' ? 'def' : 'spd'
508:     const A = this.statValue(side, atkStat)
509:     const D = this.statValue(side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player', defStat)
510:     const eff = effectiveness(skill.element, defenderSp.element)
511:     const critChance = 0.0625 + (skill.crit || 0) + (getPassive(getMonster(attacker.speciesId).passive).kind === 'critBoost' ? 0.12 : 0)
512:     const crit = Math.random() < critChance
513:     let mult = eff * (crit ? 1.5 : 1) * (0.88 + Math.random() * 0.12)
514:     // attacker passives
515:     const atkSp = getMonster(attacker.speciesId)
516:     const atkPassive = getPassive(atkSp.passive)
517:     const hpRatio = attacker.hp / maxHpOf(attacker)
518:     const night = isNight(this.state.time.minutes)
519:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'lowHpBoost' && atkPassive.element === skill.element && hpRatio < 1 / 3) mult *= atkPassive.value
520:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'elementBoost' && atkPassive.element === skill.element) mult *= atkPassive.value
521:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'nightBoost' && night) mult *= atkPassive.value
522:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'dayBoost' && !night) mult *= atkPassive.value
523:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'finisher' && defender.hp / maxHpOf(defender) < 0.5) mult *= atkPassive.value
524:     // defender passives
525:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'damageReduce' && defenderPassive.category === skill.category) mult *= defenderPassive.value
526:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'elementReduce' && defenderPassive.element === skill.element) mult *= defenderPassive.value
527:     const base = (((2 * attacker.level / 5 + 2) * skill.power * A / Math.max(1, D)) / 50 + 2)
528:     let damage = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * mult))
529:     if (damage >= defender.hp && defenderPassive.kind === 'sturdy' && defender.hp === maxHpOf(defender)) damage = defender.hp - 1
530:     return { damage: Math.max(0, damage), effectiveness: eff, crit, immune: false }
531:   }
532: 
533:   chooseEnemyMove() {
534:     const moves = this.enemy.moves.map((id, index) => ({ skill: getSkill(id), index }))
535:     const usable = moves.filter(m => m.skill.cost <= this.enemyEnergy)
536:     const pool = usable.length ? usable : [{ skill: getSkill('tackle'), index: -1 }]
537:     const enemyStats = statsOf(this.enemy)
538:     let best = pool[0], bestScore = -Infinity
539:     for (const m of pool) {
540:       const skill = m.skill
541:       let score = Math.random() * 12
542:       if (skill.category === 'status') {
543:         if (skill.heal && this.enemy.hp / maxHpOf(this.enemy) < 0.45) score += 45
544:         else if (skill.stat) {
545:           const side = this.enemy
546:           score += 10
547:         } else if (skill.status && !this.active.status) score += 22
548:         else score -= 20
549:       } else {
550:         const eff = effectiveness(skill.element, getMonster(this.active.speciesId).element)
551:         score += skill.power * eff * 0.6
552:         if (eff >= 2) score += 28
553:         if (this.active.hp / maxHpOf(this.active) < 0.3) score += 12
554:         if (skill.status && !this.active.status) score += 10
555:       }
556:       if (this.trainer) score *= 1.08
557:       if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = m }
558:     }
559:     return { index: best.index < 0 ? 0 : best.index, skill: best.skill }
560:   }
561: 
562:   endOfTurn() {
563:     for (const side of ['player', 'enemy']) {
564:       const m = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
565:       if (!m || m.hp <= 0) continue
566:       const max = maxHpOf(m)
567:       // energy regen
568:       const eMap = side === 'player' ? this.energy.player : this.energy.enemy
569:       const current = eMap.get(m.uid) ?? 100
570:       eMap.set(m.uid, clamp(current + 8, 0, 100))
571:       if (side === 'player') this.events.push({ type: 'energy', side, value: eMap.get(m.uid) })
572:       // status tick
573:       if (m.status === 'burn' || m.status === 'poison') {
574:         const tick = Math.max(1, Math.floor(max * (STATUS[m.status].tick)))
575:         m.hp = Math.max(0, m.hp - tick)
576:         this.log(`${m.nickname} is hurt by ${statusName(m.status)}!`)
577:         this.events.push({ type: 'damage', side, amount: tick, hp: m.hp, maxHp: max, statusTick: m.status })
578:       }
579:       // seeded
580:       if (this.seeded[side]) {
581:         const drain = Math.max(1, Math.floor(max / 8))
582:         m.hp = Math.max(0, m.hp - drain)
583:         const other = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
584:         if (other.hp > 0) other.hp = Math.min(maxHpOf(other), other.hp + drain)
585:         this.log(`${m.nickname}'s life is drained by the seed!`)
586:         this.events.push({ type: 'damage', side, amount: drain, hp: m.hp, maxHp: max, seeded: true })
587:       }
588:       // passive healing
589:       const passive = getPassive(getMonster(m.speciesId).passive)
590:       const night = isNight(this.state.time.minutes)
591:       let heal = 0
592:       if (passive.kind === 'healPerTurn') heal = Math.floor(max * passive.value)
593:       if (passive.kind === 'dayHeal' && !night) heal = Math.max(heal, Math.floor(max * passive.value))
594:       if (heal > 0 && m.hp > 0) {
595:         m.hp = Math.min(max, m.hp + heal)
596:         this.events.push({ type: 'heal', side, amount: heal, hp: m.hp, maxHp: max, passiveHeal: true })
597:       }
598:       if (m.hp > 0 && m.status === 'sleep' && m.statusTurns > 0) m.statusTurns++
599:     }
600:     this.checkFaints(true)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues: healer/“Helar” and buttons sometimes do not work, show player EXP instead of monster HP in the character profile, spawn higher-level monsters, and delay damage until skill animations play.
- Arrange for code to be committed and pushed from the local environment every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- The selected Git automation is local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.
- No particular healer location or exact failing button has been identified yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected battle, world-spawn, profile/HUD, inventory, and mobile-control code for likely causes.
- Prior checks found JavaScript syntax valid and the working tree clean, synchronized with `origin/opencode/43550675728`.

### Active
- Fix the healer and intermittent-button behavior.
- Adjust wild monster levels and profile EXP display.
- Make battle damage presentation wait for skill animation.
- Implement and validate a local 15-minute commit/push workflow.

### Blocked
- Exact healer/button reproduction details are still unknown.
- Local auto-push requires an agreed persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; none has been configured.

## Next Move
1. Inspect healer interactions and button event handling to identify and fix the failures.
2. Update wild encounter level selection, profile display, and battle animation/state presentation.
3. Add a safe local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then test it and report required runtime/credential setup.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle turns mutate HP before UI event playback; invalid item actions may still advance the turn or trigger an enemy action.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle state and processes animation/event playback.
- `src/game/world.js`: Wild monster selection and level assignment in `spawnWild()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild level ranges for each biome.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and monster-selection displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently includes the lead monster’s HP.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: Field item validation and use, relevant to healing.
- `src/app.js`: Mobile action/D-pad pointer event handling.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found; local auto-push was selected instead.

## Important Context
- The battle engine mutates HP in `useMove()` before `BattleUI.play()` processes the `move` event, which likely explains early damage display.
- `spawnWild()` chooses levels directly from each biome’s configured range; the starting forest range is level 3–9, lower than later biomes.
- `src/ui/screens.js` already displays monster EXP in the monster detail view; the requested character-profile location still needs to be pinpointed.
- No files have been changed in this turn.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues with healer/button interactions, character-profile EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Local auto-push was selected; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.
- No exact healer location or failing button has been identified.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant battle, spawn, profile/HUD, inventory, and mobile-control code; no files have been changed.

### Active
- Fix healer and intermittent-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and character-profile EXP display.
- Delay visible battle damage until skill animation plays.
- Implement and validate a local 15-minute commit/push workflow.

### Blocked
- Exact healer/button reproduction details are unknown.
- Auto-push still needs a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect healer interactions and button event handling to find and fix failures.
2. Update wild level selection and profile EXP display; delay battle HP presentation until the skill animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle actions mutate HP before UI event playback; invalid item actions may still advance turns.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle state and processes animation/event playback.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects species and level from biome configuration.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and monster-detail displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently includes lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: Field item validation and use, relevant to healing.
- `src/app.js`: Mobile action/D-pad pointer handling.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found; local auto-push was selected.

## Important Context
- `src/game/battle.js` `useMove()` mutates HP before `BattleUI.play()` processes the `move` event, likely causing damage to appear early.
- Forest wild levels are configured as 3–9; `spawnWild()` uses the biome range directly.
- Monster detail already shows monster EXP; trainer EXP exists in `src/game/state.js`, but the requested profile location still needs identification.
- Prior checks found JavaScript syntax valid and the working tree clean and synchronized with `origin/opencode/43550675728`.

443:       case 'damage': return base * 1.1

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer and mobile button interactions, character-profile EXP, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Local auto-push was selected; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.
- No exact healer location or failing button has been identified.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant battle, spawn, profile/HUD, inventory, and mobile-control code; no files have been changed.
- Confirmed the working tree is clean and synchronized with `origin/opencode/43550675728`.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and character-profile EXP display.
- Delay visible battle damage until the skill animation plays.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push workflow.

### Blocked
- Exact healer/button reproduction details are unknown.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect healer interactions and button event handling to find and fix failures.
2. Update wild level selection and profile EXP display; delay battle HP presentation until the skill animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle actions mutate HP before UI event playback; invalid item actions may still advance turns.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle state and processes animation/event playback.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects species and level from biome configuration.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and monster-detail displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently includes lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: Field item validation and use, relevant to healing.
- `src/app.js`: Mobile action/D-pad pointer handling.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found; local auto-push was selected.

## Important Context
- `src/game/battle.js` `useMove()` mutates HP before `BattleUI.play()` processes the `move` event, likely causing damage to appear early.
- Forest wild levels are configured as 3–9; `spawnWild()` uses the biome range directly.
- Monster detail already shows monster EXP; trainer EXP exists in `src/game/state.js`, but the requested profile location still needs identification.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, character-profile EXP, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, UI, interaction, spawning, and EXP code; no files have been changed.
- Confirmed the working tree was clean and synchronized with `origin/opencode/43550675728` at the time of inspection.
- Identified that `Battle.useMove()` mutates HP before `BattleUI.play()` handles the move event, likely causing damage to appear early.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and character-profile EXP display.
- Delay visible battle damage until the skill animation plays.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction and mobile pointer handling to find and fix the healer/button failure.
2. Update wild level selection and profile EXP display; delay battle HP presentation until the skill animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle actions mutate HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle state and processes animation/event playback.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects species and level from biome configuration; `nearestInteraction()` finds nearby interactions.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `src/app.js`: NPC interactions and mobile action/D-pad handling.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and monster-detail displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently includes lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and level state.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: Field item validation and `healAllAtNpc()`.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found.

## Important Context
- Forest wild levels are configured as 3–9; `spawnWild()` uses the biome range directly.
- Monster detail already shows monster EXP; trainer EXP exists in `src/game/state.js`, but the requested profile location still needs identification.
- `src/app.js` `interact()` uses the cached `this.near` or calls `nearestInteraction()`; healer NPCs are defined in `src/data/npcs.js`.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, character-profile EXP, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, interaction, spawning, EXP, battle UI, and mobile-control code; no files have been changed.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and character-profile EXP display.
- Delay visible battle damage until the skill animation plays.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction and mobile pointer handling to find and fix the healer/button failure.
2. Update wild level selection and profile EXP display; delay battle HP presentation until the skill animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle HP during event playback; `play()` syncs after each event.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects species and level from biome configuration; `nearestInteraction()` finds nearby interactions.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `src/app.js`: NPC interactions and mobile pointer handling.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and healer dialogue displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card shows lead-monster HP and has trainer state values available.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and level state.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: `healAllAtNpc()`.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found.

## Important Context
- Forest wild levels are configured as 3–9; `spawnWild()` uses the biome range directly.
- Trainer EXP exists in `src/game/state.js`; the exact requested profile location still needs identification.
- `src/app.js` `interact()` uses cached `this.near` or calls `nearestInteraction()`; healer NPCs are defined in `src/data/npcs.js`.
- Mobile D-pad buttons release on `pointerleave`; the action button interacts on `pointerdown` and clears its pressed state on release/cancel/leave.
- `Battle.useMove()` mutates HP before `BattleUI.play()` handles the move event, so the first `sync()` during playback can show damage before the animation.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues with healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, interaction, spawning, EXP, battle UI, and mobile-control code; no files have been changed.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and character-profile EXP display.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the skill animation plays.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction and mobile pointer handling to find and fix the healer/button failure.
2. Update wild level selection and trainer EXP display; delay battle HP presentation until the skill animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Renders battle HP during event playback; `play()` syncs after each event.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects species and level from biome configuration; `nearestInteraction()` finds nearby interactions.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `src/app.js`: NPC interactions and mobile pointer handling.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Character/profile and healer dialogue displays.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently shows lead-monster HP and has trainer state values available.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and level state.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: `healAllAtNpc()`.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files were found.

## Important Context
- Forest wild levels are configured as 3–9; `spawnWild()` uses the biome range directly.
- Trainer EXP exists in `src/game/state.js`; the exact requested profile location still needs identification.
- `src/app.js` `interact()` uses cached `this.near` or calls `nearestInteraction()`; healer NPCs are defined in `src/data/npcs.js`.
- Mobile D-pad buttons release on `pointerleave`; the action button interacts on `pointerdown` and clears its pressed state on release/cancel/leave.
- `Battle.useMove()` mutates HP before `BattleUI.play()` handles the move event, so the first `sync()` during playback can show damage before the animation.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues with healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, interaction, spawning, EXP, battle UI, mobile controls, and the existing GitHub workflow; no files have been changed.
- Confirmed the repository working tree is clean.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer EXP display.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the skill animation.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction state freshness and mobile pointer event handling; fix the interaction/button issues.
2. Update wild level selection and trainer card EXP display; ensure battle damage appears after the move animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` syncs UI after each event; inspect event handling and HP presentation.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` uses biome level ranges; `nearestInteraction()` selects the closest nearby interaction.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `src/app.js`: Interaction flow, cached `this.near`, and mobile pointer handling.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Healer dialogue and character/profile screens.
- `src/game/inventory.js`: `healAllAtNpc()`.
- `.github/workflows/`: Existing `opencode.yml`; no local 15-minute scheduler implementation is known.

## Important Context
- `interact()` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()`; `this.near` is refreshed by the exploration loop while gameplay is unblocked.
- Mobile D-pad releases on `pointerleave`; controls use pointer capture on press. The action button interacts on `pointerdown` and clears pressed state on release, cancel, or leave.
- Trainer EXP exists in `state.player.trainerXp`; `src/ui/hud.js` uses it in the trainer-card rebuild key but renders lead-monster HP instead.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, interaction, spawning, EXP, battle UI, mobile controls, and GitHub workflow code.
- Confirmed the repository was clean; no changes, commits, or pushes have been made.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer EXP display.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction freshness and mobile pointer-event handling; fix interaction/button issues.
2. Update wild level selection and trainer card EXP display; ensure battle damage appears after the move animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Interaction flow uses cached `this.near`; mobile controls use pointer events.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` handles move and damage events in sequence.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `.github/workflows/`: Existing GitHub workflow; no local 15-minute scheduler implementation is known.

## Important Context
- `interact()` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()`; `this.near` is refreshed by the exploration loop while gameplay is unblocked.
- D-pad releases on `pointerleave`; controls capture pointers on press. The action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- Trainer EXP exists in `state.player.trainerXp` and is used in the trainer-card rebuild key, but the card renders lead-monster HP instead.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made.
