## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant interaction, mobile controls, wild spawning, trainer card, battle engine, and battle UI code.
- Confirmed no changes, commits, or pushes have been made.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer EXP display.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- Exact healer location or failing button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Inspect NPC interaction freshness and mobile pointer-event handling; fix interaction/button issues.
2. Update wild level selection and trainer card EXP display; ensure battle damage appears after the move animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Interaction currently prefers cached `this.near`; mobile controls use pointer events.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` processes events and calls `sync()` after each event.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently renders lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `.github/workflows/`: Existing GitHub workflows; local scheduler not yet implemented.

## Important Context
- `interact()` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()`; `this.near` refreshes during the unblocked exploration loop.
- D-pad releases on `pointerleave`; controls capture pointers on press. The action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- Trainer EXP exists in `state.player.trainerXp` and is in the trainer-card rebuild key, but the card renders lead-monster HP instead.
- Repository branch is `opencode/43550675728`, tracking `origin/opencode/43550675728`; no commits or pushes have been made.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected interaction freshness, mobile pointer handlers, wild-level selection, trainer-card rendering, battle event playback, and healer NPC definitions.

### Active
- Fix healer interactions and intermittent mobile-button behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card EXP display.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Address stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP updates until move animation.
3. Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Interaction currently prefers cached `this.near`; mobile controls use pointer events and release on `pointerleave`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` chooses a random level from the biome range; `nearestInteraction()` selects the closest nearby entity.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently shows lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is available in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` handles each event and calls `sync()` after it.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files found in the initial listing; local scheduler not yet implemented.

## Important Context
- `interact()` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()`; `this.near` refreshes during the unblocked exploration loop.
- D-pad controls capture pointers on press but also release on `pointerleave`; the action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- Trainer EXP exists in `state.player.trainerXp`; the trainer card currently renders a lead-monster HP bar.
- `Battle.useMove()` changes HP before `BattleUI.play()` processes the `move` event, so an early `sync()` can display damage before animation.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. The branch is `opencode/43550675728`, tracking `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant interaction, mobile controls, wild-level selection, trainer-card rendering, battle event playback, healer NPC, and biome-level code.
- Confirmed no repository changes have been made; branch tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728`.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Recompute the nearby interaction when interacting; correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Cached `this.near` interaction target and mobile pointer handlers.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` handles events and calls `sync()` after each one.
- `src/data/npcs.js`: Healer NPC definitions and locations.
- `styles.css`: Mobile control styling and trainer HP bar visibility.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files found.

## Important Context
- `interact()` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()`; `this.near` updates in the exploration loop.
- D-pad controls capture pointers but also release on `pointerleave`; the action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- Trainer EXP is stored at `state.player.trainerXp`; the trainer card currently renders a lead-monster HP bar.
- `Battle.useMove()` changes HP before `BattleUI.play()` processes the `move` event, so an early `sync()` can display damage before animation.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch: `opencode/43550675728`, tracking `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving healer/mobile-button interactions, trainer EXP display, wild monster levels, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State

### Completed
- Further inspected interaction selection, mobile pointer handlers, trainer card rendering, and battle event playback; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials.

## Next Move
1. Recompute the nearby interaction when interacting; correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism, then report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; D-pad pointer capture is paired with `pointerleave` release, and the action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently renders lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is included in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` handles events and calls `sync()` after each one.
- `styles.css`: Mobile control styling and trainer HP bar visibility.
- `.github/workflows/`: No workflow files found.

## Important Context
- `BattleUI.handleEvent()` animates the move on the `move` event and hit/effects on `damage`; `play()` syncs immediately after each event. The battle model has already applied damage while generating events, before playback.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch: `opencode/43550675728`, tracking `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interaction/mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, HUD, battle, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push needs a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; credential availability and runtime persistence are unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; mobile D-pad captures pointers but releases on `pointerleave`; action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card displays lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is included in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` animates events and calls `sync()` after each one.
- `styles.css`: Mobile trainer card currently shows the HP bar; relevant mobile-control styling.
- `.github/workflows/`: Contains `opencode.yml`; no auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `BattleUI.handleEvent()` animates the move on the `move` event and hit/effects on `damage`; the battle model has already applied damage while generating events, before playback.
- `trainerProgress(state)` is available in `src/game/state.js`.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions/mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, HUD, battle, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push needs a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; credential availability and runtime persistence are unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; mobile D-pad captures pointers but releases on `pointerleave`; action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` level selection and `nearestInteraction()`.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Biome wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card displays lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is included in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` animates events and calls `sync()` after each one.
- `styles.css`: Mobile trainer card shows the HP bar; relevant mobile-control styling.
- `.github/workflows/`: Contains `opencode.yml`; no auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `BattleUI.handleEvent()` animates the move on the `move` event and hit/effects on `damage`; the battle model has already applied damage while generating events, before playback.
- `trainerProgress(state)` is available in `src/game/state.js`.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions/mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, and battle damage timing.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, HUD, battle, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push needs a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; credential availability and runtime persistence are unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; mobile D-pad releases on `pointerleave`; action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects levels from biome ranges; `nearestInteraction()` finds nearby targets.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card displays lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: `useMove()` mutates combatant HP before UI event playback.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: `play()` animates events and calls `sync()` after each one.
- `styles.css`: Mobile trainer card shows the HP bar.
- `.github/workflows/`: No auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `BattleUI.handleEvent()` animates moves on `move` events and damage effects on `damage` events, but battle HP is mutated before playback.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions, mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, battle damage timing, energy, and available moves.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Energy should decrease during battles.
- Monsters should be able to use every move they have learned in battle.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, HUD, battle, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Investigate why battle energy appears not to decrease.
- Make all learned moves available in battle.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push needs a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; credential availability and runtime persistence are unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Diagnose energy display/consumption behavior and make the full learned move pool selectable in battle.
4. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle energy consumption, enemy move selection, and turn events.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: `learned`, the four-move battle limit, and move-pool helpers.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move selection and event playback/sync.
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; mobile D-pad releases on `pointerleave`; action button interacts on `pointerdown`.
- `src/game/world.js`: `spawnWild()` selects levels from biome ranges; `nearestInteraction()` finds nearby targets.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges, including forest `[3, 9]`.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card displays lead-monster HP; `trainerXp` is in its rebuild key.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `.github/workflows/`: No auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `useMove()` subtracts skill cost from energy; `endOfTurn()` restores 8 energy, and Tackle costs 0. `BattleUI.play()` syncs after each event.
- Monsters track `learned` moves but `moves` is capped at `MAX_MOVES = 4`; battle UI renders only `active.moves`.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` (`https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`).
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions, mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, battle damage timing, energy, and available moves.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Energy should decrease during battles.
- Monsters should be able to use every move they have learned in battle.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected gameplay, battle, HUD, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Diagnose energy display and consumption behavior.
- Make the full learned move pool selectable and usable in battle.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; both remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
4. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Cached interaction selection and mobile D-pad/action-button pointer handlers.
- `src/game/world.js`: Wild spawning and nearby-interaction selection.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Energy consumption/regeneration, enemy move selection, and damage events.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Learned move pool and four-move equipped limit.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Move selection and battle event playback/sync.
- `.github/workflows/`: No auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `useMove()` subtracts skill cost; `endOfTurn()` restores 8 energy, and Tackle costs 0.
- Battle UI renders `active.moves`; `learned` may contain more moves, and `knownMovePool(monster)` exists but is not used by battle UI.
- Damage mutates HP immediately in `Battle.useMove()`; `BattleUI.play()` syncs after each event, so the HP bar may update before or alongside animation playback.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` at `https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`.
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions, mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, battle damage timing, energy, and available moves.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Energy should decrease during battles.
- Monsters should be able to use every move they have learned in battle.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected gameplay, battle, HUD, and mobile-control code; no code changes made.

### Active
- Fix stale interaction selection and mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; both remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
4. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Cached interaction selection and mobile D-pad/action-button pointer handlers.
- `src/game/world.js`: Wild spawning and nearby-interaction selection.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Energy consumption/regeneration, enemy move selection, and damage events.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Learned move pool and four-move equipped limit.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Move selection and battle event playback/sync.
- `.github/workflows/`: No auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `useMove()` subtracts skill cost; `endOfTurn()` restores 8 energy, and Tackle costs 0.
- Battle UI renders `active.moves`; `learned` may contain more moves, and `knownMovePool(monster)` exists but is not used by battle UI.
- Damage mutates HP immediately in `Battle.useMove()`; `BattleUI.play()` syncs after each event, so the HP bar may update before or alongside animation playback.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` at `https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`.
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; this does not establish that push credentials are available.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues with interactions, mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, battle damage timing, energy, and available moves.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Energy should decrease during battles.
- Monsters should be able to use every move they have learned in battle.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected gameplay, battle, HUD, mobile-control, and Git setup; no code changes made.

### Active
- Recompute nearby interactions when interacting and correct mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and trainer card to display player EXP.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until the move animation.
- Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
- Add and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push requires a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials; both remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions during `interact()` and fix pointer capture/release behavior in mobile controls.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until the move animation.
3. Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
4. Implement and validate the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: Cached interaction selection, `interact()`, and mobile D-pad/action-button pointer handlers.
- `src/game/world.js`: Wild spawning, biome-based level choice, and nearby-interaction selection.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: Wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: Trainer card currently displays lead-monster HP; `trainerProgress` is available from `src/game/state.js`.
- `src/game/state.js`: Trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Energy consumption/regeneration, enemy move selection, and immediate damage mutations/events.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Learned move pool and four-move equipped limit.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Move selection and battle event playback/sync.
- `styles.css`: HUD and trainer-card styling.
- `.github/workflows/`: No auto-push workflow was identified.

## Important Context
- `useMove()` subtracts skill cost; `endOfTurn()` restores 8 energy, and Tackle costs 0.
- Battle UI renders `active.moves`; `learned` may contain more moves, and `knownMovePool(monster)` exists but is unused by battle UI.
- Battle damage mutates HP immediately in `Battle.useMove()`; `BattleUI.play()` syncs after each event, so the HP bar may update before or alongside animation playback.
- `src/app.js` uses `this.near || this.world.nearestInteraction()` in `interact()`, so stale non-null selection persists; mobile D-pad registers `pointerleave` release, and the action button has no pointer capture.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made. Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` at `https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`.
- Local Git identity is `opencode[bot]` / `41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com`; push credentials are unverified.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix gameplay issues involving interactions, mobile controls, wild monster levels, trainer EXP display, battle damage timing, energy, and available moves.
- Set up local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Requirements
- Prefer higher-level wild monsters over low-level ones.
- Damage should not appear before the skill animation.
- Show player EXP rather than monster HP in the character profile.
- Energy should decrease during battles.
- Monsters should be able to use every move they have learned in battle.
- Automate local Git commits and pushes every 15 minutes.

## Decisions
- Use local auto-push; it requires a persistent running environment and Git credentials.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant gameplay, battle, HUD, mobile-control, and Git files; no code changes made.
- Confirmed the repository was clean at the latest status check; no new commits or pushes were made.

### Active
- Fix stale nearby-interaction selection in `interact()` and verify mobile pointer release behavior.
- Adjust wild encounter levels and display trainer EXP in the profile.
- Delay visible battle HP changes until move animations play.
- Diagnose energy behavior and expose all learned moves in battle.
- Implement and test the local 15-minute commit/push mechanism.

### Blocked
- The specific healer location or failing mobile button has not been identified.
- Auto-push still depends on a persistent scheduler/runtime and usable Git credentials, both unverified.

## Next Move
1. Recompute nearby interactions during `interact()` and verify mobile control release handling.
2. Update wild-level selection and trainer-card EXP display; delay battle HP display updates until move animations.
3. Diagnose energy behavior and enable all learned moves in battle.
4. Implement and validate the 15-minute local commit/push mechanism; report runtime and credential requirements.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: `interact()` uses cached `this.near`; mobile D-pad pointer handlers.
- `src/game/world.js`: wild spawn levels and nearby-interaction selection.
- `src/data/biomes.js`: wild-monster level ranges.
- `src/ui/hud.js`: trainer card currently includes lead-monster HP; `trainerProgress` is available in `src/game/state.js`.
- `src/game/state.js`: trainer EXP and `trainerProgress(state)`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: energy use/regeneration, enemy move selection, and damage events.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: learned move pool and four-move equipped limit.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: move selection and battle-event playback/sync.
- `styles.css`: HUD and trainer-card styling.
- `.github/workflows/`: existing workflow is issue-triggered, not an auto-push scheduler.

## Important Context
- `useMove()` subtracts skill cost; `endOfTurn()` restores 8 energy, and Tackle costs 0.
- Battle UI renders `active.moves`; `knownMovePool(monster)` exists but is unused by battle UI.
- Battle damage mutates HP immediately in `Battle.useMove()`; `BattleUI.play()` syncs after each event.
- `src/app.js` currently falls back to `this.near` before recomputing interaction proximity. The D-pad sets pointer capture but also releases on `pointerleave`; validate behavior.
- Branch `opencode/43550675728` tracks `origin/opencode/43550675728` at `https://github.com/A000000000001/Playground2`; latest observed commit was `4d5862b`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Let monsters use every move they have learned in battle, without the current four-move cap.

## Requirements
- All learned moves should be available for battle use.
- The user explicitly said to set aside the earlier gameplay requests and work on this new change.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected move storage, battle move selection, and battle UI; no files have been changed.

### Active
- Remove the four-move battle limit and make every learned move available in battle.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update battle move selection and rendering to use all learned moves, preserving move fallback behavior where needed.
2. Check whether the profile’s four-slot move management should remain as a separate feature or be updated to reflect the new requirement.
3. Run available checks and inspect the resulting diff.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/monsters.js`: `MAX_MOVES`, learned-move tracking, and `knownMovePool()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: battle action indices and enemy move selection.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: renders only `active.moves` in `renderMovePanel()`.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: profile move-slot UI and four-move management.
- `styles.css`: battle move-grid layout.

## Important Context
- `createMonster()` and `syncLearned()` currently cap `monster.moves` at four, while `monster.learned` tracks learned skills.
- `knownMovePool(monster)` already combines learned and equipped moves but is currently unused by battle UI.
- Battle engine move actions use indices into `monster.moves`; enemy selection also uses that list.
- No changes, commits, or pushes have been made.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Let monsters use every move they have learned in battle, without a four-move cap.

## Requirements
- All learned moves should be available for battle use.
- Set aside earlier gameplay requests; this is the current change.

## Decisions
- Remove the separate four-slot equipped-move management; the profile lists all available battle skills.

## Work State
### Completed
- Battle UI and engine now reference `knownMovePool()` for player and enemy moves.
- Monster creation, hatching, and level-up logic now retain learned moves without a four-move cap.
- Profile move section now presents all learned moves as available battle skills.

### Active
- Review changes for edge cases and run available checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the diff, especially fallback behavior for older saved monsters and move selection indices.
2. Run available checks and fix any issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game/monsters.js`: learned-move storage and `knownMovePool()`.
- `src/game/battle.js`: move action lookup and enemy move selection.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: renders battle move choices.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: monster profile move list.
- `styles.css`: battle move grid layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made.
- The last change updated `knownMovePool()` to fall back to `tackle` when no moves are recorded.
- `getSkill` remains used in `src/game/monsters.js` for inherited egg moves and `knownMovePool()`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Let monsters use every move they have learned in battle, without a four-move cap.

## Requirements
- All learned moves should be available for battle use.
- Remove separate equipped-move management; the profile lists all available battle skills.
- Set aside earlier gameplay requests.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and any moves stored on the monster, preserving access for older saves.
- Monsters with no recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap from monster creation, hatching, and level-up move retention.
- Updated player and enemy battle move selection to use `knownMovePool()`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Allow monsters to use all learned moves in battle without a four-move cap, remove equipped-move management, and show all available skills on the profile.
- Make battle damage appear after the attacking monster’s animation rather than before or simultaneously.

## Requirements
- Preserve access to moves in older saves.
- Monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.
- Set aside earlier gameplay requests.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- If a selected move is unaffordable, use `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap from monster creation, hatching, and level-up move retention.
- Updated player and enemy battle move selection to use `knownMovePool()`.
- Removed equipped-skill controls and displayed all available skills on the profile.
- Added a scrollable battle move grid and compatibility handling for older or incomplete monster records.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused tests for large move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.

### Active
- Adjust battle event playback so damage effects and HP updates wait until the attacker’s animation finishes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect attack animation methods and event sequencing in `src/ui/battleUI.js`.
2. Update playback timing so `damage` is handled after the corresponding `move` animation completes, then validate the change.

## Relevant Files
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle event playback, attack animation, and damage effect rendering.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Generates ordered `move` and `damage` events and updates battle state.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Move storage and `knownMovePool()`.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile battle-skill list.
- `styles.css`: Battle move grid and skill row styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made.
- `BattleUI.play()` currently handles an event, calls `sync()`, then waits for that event’s delay. `handleEvent('move')` shows the banner and calls `lunge()`; `handleEvent('damage')` displays damage effects and calls `hit()`.
- `Battle.useMove()` updates defender HP and emits `damage` synchronously while constructing the turn’s event list, before the UI plays the events.

input.prompt: Inspect src/data/monsters.js and report how learnsets are distributed/duplicated, skill counts/by element, and suggest concrete safe changes to increase move variety across species. Do not edit files. Include any generation/level-up implications.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e27a61c87ffec9P5jTuxBVvw0V" state="completed">
## Findings

`src/data/monsters.js` has **87 species and 438 learnset entries**, while `src/data/skills.js` defines **74 skills**.

- Most species have **5 learnset entries**; **3 species have 6**.
- There are **437 distinct species/skill pairs**. Celestag lists `solar_flare` at both levels 1 and 32; the second entry is redundant because the move is already learned at level 1.
- Two pairs of species share identical learnsets: **Lumimoth/Astralynx** and **Dustmoth/Starfawn**.
- The most widely assigned moves are `tackle` (34 species), `solar_flare` (16), `iron_guard` and `recover` (15 each), `crystal_lance` (14), `prism_flash` (12), and `lullaby` (11).
- Five defined skills are never learned: `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`. Other rare assignments include `thorn_burst`, `bulk_up`, `ancient_roar`, `static_jolt`, and `thunder_fang` (one species each).

### Element distribution

Catalog skill counts:

| Element | Skills |
|---|---:|
| Neutral | 15 |
| Nature | 9 |
| Shadow | 8 |
| Flame, frost, earth, light, storm, dragon | 7 each |

Across learnset entries, **116** are neutral and **283** match the species’ element; **39** are off-element. By skill element, the occurrence counts are: neutral 116, nature 43, flame 34, frost 34, earth 51, shadow 47, light 64, storm 18, dragon 31.

## Safe ways to increase variety

Prefer a few **themed, later-level unlocks** over broadly replacing early moves such as `tackle`. For example:

- Add `focus_strike` to **Scytheraptor** around level 34 as a physical option for its attack-focused kit.
- Add `fire_spin` to **Flarewing** around level 34 for a flame-themed utility move.
- Add `ancient_roar` to **Hydrarch** at a late level for a rare dragon status option.
- For Celestag, consider replacing its redundant `[32, 'solar_flare']` entry with `[32, 'dawn_blade']`. Solar Flare is already available at level 1, so this gives Celestag a distinct physical light move without increasing its entry count.

These are candidates, not balance-tested changes. Additions expand the available move pool, so it is prudent to introduce a small batch and check battle balance before broadening more learnsets. Avoid distributing every unused skill at once—particularly stronger or healing moves such as `mega_punch` and `rest`—without checking their impact.

## Generation and level-up implications

In `/home/runner/work/Playground2/Playground2/src/game/monsters.js`, `createMonster` grants every learnset move whose required level is at or below the monster’s level. That means learnset changes can affect **newly created and generated monsters immediately**, including higher-level wild monsters.

For existing monsters, a newly eligible move is added when `syncLearned` runs, such as during a level-up or evolution; it is **not automatically added just because the data changed**. Evolution syncs against the new species’ learnset. Eggs inherit up to three damaging parent moves, and hatching merges those with the base species’ moves available through level 5.

The learnset code accumulates learned moves rather than replacing an old move when a new one is learned. Thus an added entry increases the available move pool for affected instances. No files were changed.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Allow monsters to use all learned moves in battle without a four-move cap, remove equipped-move management, and show all available skills on the profile.
- Make battle damage appear after the attacker’s animation, then expand the skill catalog and give monsters more varied movesets.

## Requirements
- Preserve access to moves in older saves.
- Monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.
- Set aside earlier gameplay requests.
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- If a selected move is unaffordable, use `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap from monster creation, hatching, and level-up move retention.
- Updated player and enemy battle move selection to use `knownMovePool()`.
- Removed equipped-skill controls and displayed all available skills on the profile.
- Added a scrollable battle move grid and compatibility handling for older or incomplete monster records.
- Delayed battle damage effects and displayed HP updates until after the attacker’s animation.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused tests for move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.
- Audited learnsets: 87 species, 438 entries, 74 skills; identified unused skills and repeated moveset patterns.

### Active
- Expand move variety by adding skills and assigning more distinct, species-themed learnsets.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining learnsets in `src/data/monsters.js` and choose balanced, species-appropriate additions and replacements.
2. Update learnsets and, if needed, add new skills to `src/data/skills.js`.
3. Validate syntax, diff cleanliness, and relevant move-learning behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets to diversify.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Existing skill catalog and location for additional moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Creates monsters and syncs learned moves from learnsets.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Uses the full learned move pool and sequences battle animations and damage display.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Generates battle move and damage events.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made.
- Learnset additions affect newly created monsters immediately; existing monsters gain newly eligible moves when `syncLearned` runs, such as on level-up or evolution.
- Five existing skills are currently unused: `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
- Celestag has a redundant `solar_flare` learnset entry; Lumimoth/Astralynx and Dustmoth/Starfawn share identical learnsets.

## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and give monsters more varied, species-appropriate learnsets.
- Earlier requests to remove the move cap and equipped-move management, and to sequence battle damage after animations, are completed; set aside other gameplay requests.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Preserve access to moves in older saves; monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap, equipped-move controls, and displayed all available skills on the profile.
- Added compatibility for older or incomplete monster records, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused tests for move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.
- Audited learnsets: 87 species, 438 entries, 74 skills; identified unused skills and repeated moveset patterns.

### Active
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add balanced, species-appropriate skills and assign more distinct learnsets in `src/data/monsters.js`.
2. Consider using currently unused skills: `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
3. Validate syntax, diff cleanliness, and relevant move-learning behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; contains repeated patterns and the redundant Celestag `solar_flare` entry.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and location for new moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Creates monsters and syncs learned moves from learnsets.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Interprets skill effects and selects battle moves.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Displays moves and sequences battle animations and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made. Current modified files: `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` share identical learnsets.

## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Preserve access to moves in older saves; monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.
- Set aside other gameplay requests already completed in the earlier work.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older or incomplete monster records, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Audited learnsets: 87 species, 438 entries, 74 skills; identified unused skills and repeated moveset patterns.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused tests for move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.

### Active
- Expand the move catalog and diversify species learnsets in `src/data/monsters.js`.
- Consider assigning currently unused skills: `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add balanced, species-appropriate skills and assign more distinct learnsets in `src/data/monsters.js`.
2. Validate syntax, diff cleanliness, and relevant move-learning behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; includes repeated patterns and the redundant Celestag `solar_flare` entry.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and candidate unused moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Creates monsters and syncs learned moves from learnsets.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Interprets skill effects and selects battle moves.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Displays moves and sequences battle animations and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made. Modified files: `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` share identical learnsets.
- `src/data/monsters.js` has defensive learnset overrides for `tombwarden` and `dracoil`; the inline Tombwarden learnset contains `['rock', 'stone']`, while the override replaces it.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Preserve access to moves in older saves; monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.
- Set aside other gameplay requests already completed earlier.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older or incomplete monster records, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Audited learnsets: 87 species, 438 entries, 74 skills; identified unused skills and repeated moveset patterns.
- Added new species-appropriate catalog moves in `src/data/skills.js`: `pollen_dance`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, `moonbeam`, `thunderclap`, and `scale_rend`.
- Assigned several existing and new skills to species learnsets in `src/data/monsters.js`, including unused skills such as `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
- Previous work passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused tests for move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.

### Active
- Continue diversifying species learnsets and use the newly added catalog moves where appropriate.
- Validate syntax, diff cleanliness, and relevant move-learning behavior after changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining learnsets and assign `scale_rend` and other suitable moves to additional species.
2. Check for duplicate or awkward learnset entries and maintain appropriate progression levels.
3. Run syntax checks, `git diff --check`, and focused move-learning tests.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; includes defensive learnset overrides for `tombwarden` and `dracoil`.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog, including newly added moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation and learnset synchronization.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Skill effects and battle move selection.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made.
- Modified files include `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, `styles.css`, `src/data/skills.js`, and `src/data/monsters.js`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` previously shared identical learnsets.
- Celestag's redundant `solar_flare` entry was replaced with `dawn_blade`, `moonbeam`, and a later `draco_meteor` entry.

527: export function evolutionOptions(monster, biome = null) {
528:   const species = getMonster(monster.speciesId)
529:   if (!species.evolutions) return []
530:   return species.evolutions.filter(evo => {
531:     switch (evo.type) {
532:       case 'level': return monster.level >= evo.level
533:       case 'item': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1)
534:       case 'friendship': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1) && monster.friendship >= (evo.friendship || 70)
535:       case 'location': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1) && (!biome || biome === evo.biome)
536:       default: return false
537:     }
538:   })
539: }

541: export function baseSpeciesId(speciesId) {
542:   // Walk backwards to the first evolution stage (used by breeding).
543:   let current = getMonster(speciesId)
544:   let guard = 0
545:   while (guard++ < 10) {
546:     const parent = MONSTER_LIST.find(m => m.evolutions.some(e => e.to === current.id))
547:     if (!parent) return current.id
548:     current = parent
549:   }
550:   return current.id
551: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Preserve access to moves in older saves; monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older or incomplete monster records, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Added catalog moves: `pollen_dance`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, `moonbeam`, `thunderclap`, and `scale_rend`.
- Expanded and diversified learnsets with new moves and previously unused skills, including `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
- Added further learnset assignments in this turn, including `pollen_dance`, `moonbeam`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, and `scale_rend` for suitable species.
- Prior focused checks covered move pools, legacy saves, missing move fields, and enemy energy fallback.

### Active
- Validate current catalog and learnset changes for syntax, duplicate/awkward entries, and move-learning behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining learnsets and continue appropriate use of `scale_rend` and other new moves.
2. Run syntax checks and `git diff --check`; run focused move-learning tests.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; includes defensive learnset overrides for `tombwarden` and `dracoil`.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation and learnset synchronization.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Skill effects and battle move selection.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made.
- Modified files: `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` previously shared identical learnsets.
- Recent inspection shows `tombwarden` and `dracoil` learnsets are corrected defensively after catalog initialization.

526: // Evolution helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
527: export function evolutionOptions(monster, biome = null) {
528:   const species = getMonster(monster.speciesId)
529:   if (!species.evolutions) return []
530:   return species.evolutions.filter(evo => {
531:     switch (evo.type) {
532:       case 'level': return monster.level >= evo.level
533:       case 'item': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1)
534:       case 'friendship': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1) && monster.friendship >= (evo.friendship || 70)
535:       case 'location': return monster.level >= (evo.level || 1) && (!biome || biome === evo.biome)
536:       default: return false
537:     }
538:   })
539: }

541: export function baseSpeciesId(speciesId) {
542:   // Walk backwards to the first evolution stage (used by breeding).
543:   let current = getMonster(speciesId)
544:   let guard = 0
545:   while (guard++ < 10) {
546:     const parent = MONSTER_LIST.find(m => m.evolutions.some(e => e.to === current.id))
547:     if (!parent) return current.id
548:     current = parent
549:   }
550:   return current.id
551: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Preserve access to moves in older saves; monsters without recorded moves fall back to `tackle`.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older or incomplete monster records, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Added catalog moves: `pollen_dance`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, `moonbeam`, `thunderclap`, and `scale_rend`.
- Expanded and diversified learnsets with new moves and previously unused skills, including `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
- Added further learnset assignments, including `pollen_dance`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, and `scale_rend`.
- Added `pollen_dance` to Mosswarden, `aurora_burst` to a learnset, `fault_line` and `wraith_claw` to suitable learnsets, and `scale_rend` to two dragon learnsets.

### Active
- Validate catalog and learnset changes for syntax, duplicate or awkward entries, and move-learning behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.
- Preserve older-save move access, with `tackle` as the fallback when no moves are recorded.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Maintain access to learned and monster-stored moves in battle.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added older/incomplete-record compatibility, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Added eight catalog moves: `pollen_dance`, `ash_blast`, `aurora_burst`, `fault_line`, `wraith_claw`, `moonbeam`, `thunderclap`, and `scale_rend`.
- Expanded and diversified learnsets with new and previously unused moves, including `focus_strike`, `mega_punch`, `rest`, `fire_spin`, and `dawn_blade`.
- Added suitable learnset assignments for the new moves; corrected Celestag’s learnset to include `dawn_blade` and `moonbeam` instead of a duplicate `solar_flare`.
- `git diff --check` completed without output.

### Active
- Validate catalog and learnset changes for syntax, duplicate or awkward entries, and move-learning behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks and focused move-learning tests; no `package.json` or test/spec files were found in the repository scan.
2. Review remaining learnsets for suitable assignments of `scale_rend` and other new moves.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets and recent move assignments.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and new moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation, learnset synchronization, and known move pool.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle move selection and effects.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made. Modified files: `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` previously shared identical learnsets.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves.
- Preserve older-save move access, with `tackle` as the fallback when no moves are recorded.

## Requirements
- Add more moves and give monsters different sets of moves.
- Maintain access to learned and monster-stored moves in battle.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added older/incomplete-record compatibility, a scrollable battle move grid, and delayed battle damage/HP display until after attack animations.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets with new and previously unused moves.
- Added learnset assignments for the new moves; corrected Celestag’s learnset to include `dawn_blade` and `moonbeam` instead of duplicate `solar_flare`.
- `git diff --check` completed without output; reviewed relevant move assignments, including `scale_rend`.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript syntax and move-learning/battle behavior; no test files or `package.json` were found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks and focused move-pool/learning checks.
2. Review remaining learnsets for awkward or duplicate entries and appropriate assignments.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets and recent move assignments.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and new moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation, learnset synchronization, and known move pool.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Battle move selection and effects.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and damage display.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push has been made. Modified files: `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- `Lumimoth`/`Astralynx` and `Dustmoth`/`Starfawn` previously shared identical learnsets.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves while preserving battle access to learned and monster-stored moves.

## Requirements
- Keep access to learned and monster-stored moves in battle; use `tackle` when no moves are recorded or when a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added older/incomplete-record compatibility and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets, including correcting Celestag’s duplicate `solar_flare` entry to `dawn_blade` and `moonbeam`.
- JavaScript syntax checks passed for the six modified JavaScript files; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Validate move-learning and battle behavior; review remaining learnsets for questionable entries or duplicates.
- Inspect the suspicious Tombwarden learnset entry `[[1, 'rock', 'stone'], ...]` in `src/data/monsters.js`.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Check and correct the Tombwarden learnset entry if confirmed invalid.
2. Run focused checks for move-pool compatibility, level-up learning, affordability fallback, and enemy fallback.
3. Review remaining learnsets for awkward or duplicate entries.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets, including recent assignments and the suspicious Tombwarden entry.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and eight added moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation, learnset synchronization, and known move pool.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Player/enemy move selection and affordability behavior.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and HP display timing.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; modified files: `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves while preserving battle access to learned and monster-stored moves.

## Requirements
- Keep access to learned and monster-stored moves in battle; use `tackle` when no moves are recorded or when a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added older/incomplete-record compatibility and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets, including correcting Celestag’s duplicate `solar_flare` entry to `dawn_blade` and `moonbeam`.
- JavaScript syntax checks passed for six modified JavaScript files; `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Fix and validate the apparently malformed Tombwarden learnset entry `[[1, 'rock', 'stone'], ...]`.
- Validate move-pool compatibility, level-up learning, affordability fallback, and enemy fallback.
- Review remaining learnsets for questionable or duplicate entries.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and correct Tombwarden’s learnset entry in `src/data/monsters.js`.
2. Run focused checks for move-pool compatibility, level-up learning, affordability fallback, and enemy fallback.
3. Review remaining learnsets for awkward or duplicate entries.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; includes the suspicious Tombwarden entry.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and eight added moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation, learnset synchronization, and known move pool.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Player/enemy move selection and affordability behavior.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and HP display timing.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in the seven listed files.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the move catalog and diversify monster learnsets with species-appropriate moves while preserving battle access to learned and monster-stored moves.

## Requirements
- Keep battle access to learned and monster-stored moves; use `tackle` when no moves are recorded or when a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and moves stored on the monster.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemies use `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes appear after the corresponding attack animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles display all available skills.
- Added older/incomplete-record compatibility and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets, including correcting Celestag’s duplicate `solar_flare` entry.
- Corrected Tombwarden’s malformed learnset entry and Dracoil’s `coil` entry to `tail_swipe`.
- Validated all 87 species’ learnset entry shapes, skill IDs, and duplicate move IDs; no issues found.

### Active
- Validate move-pool compatibility, level-up learning, affordability fallback, and enemy fallback.
- Review remaining learnsets for questionable entries.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Run focused checks for move-pool compatibility, level-up learning, affordability fallback, and enemy fallback.
2. Review remaining learnsets for awkward or questionable entries.
3. Run syntax checks and `git diff --check` after the latest edits.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species learnsets; Tombwarden and Dracoil entries were corrected.
- `src/data/skills.js`: Skill catalog and eight added moves.
- `src/game/monsters.js`: Monster creation, learnset synchronization, and known move pool.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Player/enemy move selection and affordability behavior.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle move display, attack animations, and HP display timing.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Profile skill display.
- `styles.css`: Battle move-grid styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in the seven listed files.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
