messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- Current skill elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`; no element or dual-type edits have been made yet.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.

82:     const p = this.active
83:     if (this.trainer) {
84:       this.log(`${this.trainer.name} challenges you!`)
85:       this.log(`${this.trainer.name} sent out ${e.nickname}!`)
86:     } else if (this.kind === 'boss' || this.kind === 'mythic') {
87:       this.log(`${this.source.entity?.name || getMonster(e.speciesId).name} blocks your path!`)
88:     } else {
89:       this.log(`A wild ${getMonster(e.speciesId).name} appeared!`)
90:     }
91:     this.log(`Go, ${p.nickname}!`)
92:     // on-entry passives
93:     this.onEntry('enemy', 'player')
94:     this.onEntry('player', 'enemy')
95:     return this.events
96:   }

98:   onEntry(side, foeSide) {
99:     const m = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
100:     const sp = getMonster(m.speciesId)
101:     const passive = getPassive(sp.passive)
102:     if (passive.kind === 'onEntry') {
103:       this.applyStage(foeSide, passive.stat, passive.stages, `${getMonster(this[foeSide === 'player' ? 'active' : 'enemy'].speciesId).name}`)
104:       this.log(`${getMonster(m.speciesId).name}'s ${passive.name} ${stageName(passive.stages)} the foe's ${passive.stat.toUpperCase()}!`)
105:     }
106:   }
107: 
108:   addParticipant() {
109:     if (this.active) this.participants.add(this.active.uid)
110:   }
111: 
112:   stageOf(side, stat) { return this.stages[side][stat] || 0 }
113: 
114:   applyStage(side, stat, stages, label) {
115:     if (!stat || !(stat in this.stages[side])) return
116:     this.stages[side][stat] = clamp(this.stages[side][stat] + stages, -6, 6)
117:   }
118: 
119:   statValue(side, stat) {
120:     const m = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
121:     const stats = statsOf(m)
122:     let value = stats[stat] || 1
123:     if (stat !== 'hp') value *= stageMultiplier(this.stageOf(side, stat))
124:     if (stat === 'atk' && m.status === 'burn') value *= 0.5
125:     if (stat === 'spe' && m.status === 'paralysis') value *= 0.5
126:     return Math.max(1, value)
127:   }

129:   // ── player actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
130:   takeTurn(action) {
131:     if (this.over) return { events: [], over: true, result: this.result }
132:     if (this.awaitingSwitch) return { events: [], awaitingSwitch: true }
133:     this.events = []
134:     this.turn++
135: 
136:     if (action.type === 'switch') return this.doSwitchTurn(action.index)
137:     if (action.type === 'item') return this.doItemTurn(action)
138:     if (action.type === 'capture') return this.doCaptureTurn(action)
139:     if (action.type === 'escape') return this.doEscapeTurn()
140:     if (action.type === 'move') return this.doMoveTurn(action.index)
141:     return { events: [], over: false }
142:   }
143: 
144:   doMoveTurn(index) {
145:     const selectedPlayerMove = knownMovePool(this.active)[index] || getSkill('tackle')
146:     const playerMove = selectedPlayerMove.cost <= this.activeEnergy ? selectedPlayerMove : getSkill('tackle')
147:     const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
148:     const playerPriority = playerMove.priority || 0
149:     const enemyPriority = enemyMove.priority || 0
150:     const playerSpeed = this.statValue('player', 'spe')
151:     const enemySpeed = this.statValue('enemy', 'spe')
152:     const playerFirst = playerPriority > enemyPriority || (playerPriority === enemyPriority && (playerSpeed > enemySpeed || (playerSpeed === enemySpeed && Math.random() < 0.5)))
153: 
154:     const order = playerFirst ? ['player', 'enemy'] : ['enemy', 'player']
155:     for (const side of order) {
156:       if (this.over) break
157:       if (side === 'player' && this.active.hp <= 0) continue
158:       if (side === 'enemy' && this.enemy.hp <= 0) continue
159:       if (side === 'player') this.useMove('player', index)
160:       else this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
161:       const faints = this.checkFaints()
162:       if (faints.enemyFainted || faints.playerFainted) break
163:     }
164:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
165:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
166:   }
167: 
168:   doSwitchTurn(index) {
169:     const m = this.playerParty[index]
170:     if (!m || m.hp <= 0 || index === this.activeIndex) {
171:       this.log('That monster cannot battle right now.')
172:       return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true }
173:     }
174:     this.switchPlayer(index, true)
175:     const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
176:     if (!this.over) this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
177:     this.checkFaints()
178:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
179:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
180:   }
181: 
182:   doItemTurn(action) {
183:     const result = this.useBattleItem(action.itemId, action.targetIndex)
184:     if (result?.fled) return this.finishTurnEvents()
185:     if (!this.over) {
186:       const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
187:       this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
188:       this.checkFaints()
189:     }
190:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
191:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
192:   }
193: 
194:   doCaptureTurn(action) {
195:     const item = getItem(action.itemId)
196:     if (!this.canCapture) { this.log('You cannot capture another trainer\'s monster!'); return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true } }
197:     if (item.type !== 'orb') return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true }
198:     if ((this.state.inventory[action.itemId] || 0) <= 0) { this.log(`You are out of ${item.name}.`); return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true } }
199:     // consume
200:     this.state.inventory[action.itemId]--
201:     if (this.state.inventory[action.itemId] <= 0) delete this.state.inventory[action.itemId]
202:     const chance = this.captureChance(action.itemId)
203:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-throw', itemId: action.itemId, chance, speciesId: this.enemy.speciesId })
204:     this.log(`You threw a ${item.name}!`)
205:     const roll = Math.random()
206:     const shakes = roll < chance ? 3 : roll < chance * 1.8 ? 2 : roll < chance * 2.8 ? 1 : 0
207:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-shake', shakes, chance })
208:     if (roll < chance) {
209:       this.log(`${getMonster(this.enemy.speciesId).name} was caught!`)
210:       const caught = this.enemy
211:       caught.status = null
212:       caught.statusTurns = 0
213:       caught.caughtAt = Date.now()
214:       caught.caughtBiome = this.biome
215:       caught.caughtNight = isNight(this.state.time.minutes)
216:       recordCatch(this.state, caught, { night: caught.caughtNight })
217:       const toParty = addMonster(this.state, caught)
218:       this.caughtMonster = caught
219:       this.rewards.money = 0
220:       this.events.push({ type: 'captured', monster: caught, toParty, speciesId: caught.speciesId })
221:       this.result = 'caught'
222:       this.over = true
223:       this.state.stats.battles++
224:       return this.finishTurnEvents()
225:     }
226:     this.log('Oh no! The monster broke free!')
227:     this.events.push({ type: 'capture-fail' })
228:     const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
229:     if (!this.over) this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
230:     this.checkFaints()
231:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
232:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
233:   }
234: 
235:   doEscapeTurn() {
236:     if (!this.canEscape) {
237:       this.log('There is no running from this battle!')
238:       return { events: this.events, over: false, rejected: true }
239:     }
240:     const ps = statsOf(this.active).spe
241:     const es = statsOf(this.enemy).spe
242:     const chance = clamp(0.5 + (ps - es) / 160, 0.25, 0.95)
243:     if (Math.random() < chance) {
244:       this.log('You got away safely!')
245:       this.result = 'escaped'
246:       this.over = true
247:       this.state.stats.battles++
248:       this.events.push({ type: 'escaped' })
249:       return this.finishTurnEvents()
250:     }
251:     this.log('You failed to escape!')
252:     this.events.push({ type: 'escape-fail' })
253:     const enemyMove = this.chooseEnemyMove()
254:     this.useMove('enemy', enemyMove.index)
255:     this.checkFaints()
256:     if (!this.over) this.endOfTurn()
257:     return this.finishTurnEvents()
258:   }
259: 
260:   useBattleItem(itemId, targetIndex) {
261:     const item = getItem(itemId)
262:     if ((this.state.inventory[itemId] || 0) <= 0) { this.log(`You have no ${item.name} left.`); return null }
263:     const target = this.playerParty[targetIndex ?? this.activeIndex]
264:     if (!target) return null
265:     if (item.type === 'orb') { this.log('Use the Capture action to throw an orb.'); return null }
266:     if (item.escape) {
267:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
268:       if (this.state.inventory[itemId] <= 0) delete this.state.inventory[itemId]
269:       if (!this.canEscape) { this.log('The rope fizzles. This battle cannot be escaped!'); return null }
270:       this.log('You used an Escape Rope!')
271:       this.result = 'escaped'; this.over = true; this.state.stats.battles++
272:       this.events.push({ type: 'escaped' })
273:       return { fled: true }
274:     }
275:     if (item.type === 'potion') {
276:       if (target.hp <= 0) { this.log(`${target.nickname} has fainted. Use a Revive Shard.`); return null }
277:       if (target.hp >= maxHpOf(target) && !item.cure) { this.log(`${target.nickname} is already at full HP.`); return null }
278:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
279:       if (this.state.inventory[itemId] <= 0) delete this.state.inventory[itemId]
280:       const max = maxHpOf(target)
281:       const before = target.hp
282:       target.hp = item.heal === 'full' ? max : Math.min(max, target.hp + item.heal)
283:       if (item.cure) target.status = null
284:       this.log(`You used ${item.name} on ${target.nickname}.`)
285:       this.events.push({ type: 'heal-item', side: target === this.active ? 'player' : 'bench', targetUid: target.uid, amount: target.hp - before, hp: target.hp, maxHp: max })
286:       return { ok: true }
287:     }
288:     if (item.type === 'cure') {
289:       if (!target.status) { this.log('It has no effect.'); return null }
290:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
291:       target.status = null
292:       this.log(`${target.nickname} was cured of ${item.cure.join(', ')}.`)
293:       this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side: 'player', targetUid: target.uid })
294:       return { ok: true }
295:     }
296:     if (item.type === 'battle' && item.energy) {
297:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
298:       this.energy.player.set(target.uid, clamp((this.energy.player.get(target.uid) ?? 100) + item.energy, 0, 100))
299:       this.log(`${target.nickname} recovered energy!`)
300:       this.events.push({ type: 'energy', side: 'player', value: this.energy.player.get(target.uid) })
301:       return { ok: true }
302:     }
303:     if (item.type === 'revive') {
304:       if (target.hp > 0) { this.log('That monster has not fainted.'); return null }
305:       this.state.inventory[itemId]--
306:       target.hp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxHpOf(target) * item.revive))
307:       this.log(`${target.nickname} was revived!`)
308:       this.events.push({ type: 'revive', targetUid: target.uid, hp: target.hp, maxHp: maxHpOf(target) })
309:       return { ok: true }
310:     }
311:     this.log('That item cannot be used in battle.')
312:     return null
313:   }
314: 
315:   // ── move use ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
316:   useMove(side, moveIndex) {
317:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
318:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
319:     const skill = knownMovePool(attacker)[moveIndex] || getSkill('tackle')
320:     const attackerLabel = side === 'player' ? attacker.nickname : `${getMonster(attacker.speciesId).name}`
321:     if (attacker.hp <= 0) return
322: 
323:     // status check
324:     if (this.statusPreventsAction(side)) return
325: 
326:     // energy
327:     const energy = side === 'player' ? this.activeEnergy : this.enemyEnergy
328:     let usedSkill = skill
329:     if (skill.cost > energy) {
330:       usedSkill = getSkill('tackle')
331:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} is low on energy and uses Tackle!`)
332:     } else {
333:       if (side === 'player') this.activeEnergy = energy - skill.cost
334:       else this.enemyEnergy = energy - skill.cost
335:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} used ${skill.name}!`)
336:     }
337:     this.events.push({
338:       type: 'move', side, moveId: usedSkill.id, moveName: usedSkill.name,
339:       element: usedSkill.element, energy: side === 'player' ? this.activeEnergy : this.enemyEnergy,
340:     })
341: 
342:     // status moves
343:     if (usedSkill.category === 'status') {
344:       const accStage = this.stageOf(side, 'acc')
345:       const accuracy = clamp((usedSkill.accuracy || 100) * stageMultiplier(accStage) / 100, 0.05, 1)
346:       if (Math.random() > accuracy) {
347:         this.log(`${defender.nickname} avoided the attack!`)
348:         this.events.push({ type: 'miss', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
349:         return
350:       }
351:       this.applySkillEffect(side, usedSkill, true)
352:       return
353:     }
354: 
355:     // accuracy
356:     const accStage = this.stageOf(side, 'acc')
357:     const accuracy = clamp((usedSkill.accuracy || 100) * stageMultiplier(accStage) / 100, 0.05, 1)
358:     if (Math.random() > accuracy) {
359:       this.log(`${defender.nickname} avoided the attack!`)
360:       this.events.push({ type: 'miss', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
361:       return
362:     }
363: 
364:     const hits = usedSkill.multi || 1
365:     for (let i = 0; i < hits; i++) {
366:       const res = this.calculateDamage(side, usedSkill)
367:       if (res.immune) {
368:         this.log(`${getMonster(defender.speciesId).name} is immune to ${usedSkill.element} attacks!`)
369:         this.events.push({ type: 'immune', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player' })
370:         return
371:       }
372:       defender.hp = Math.max(0, defender.hp - res.damage)
373:       const effLabel = effectivenessLabel(res.effectiveness)
374:       this.events.push({
375:         type: 'damage', side: side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player',
376:         amount: res.damage, crit: res.crit, effectiveness: res.effectiveness,
377:         hp: defender.hp, maxHp: maxHpOf(defender), element: usedSkill.element,
378:         effLabel: effLabel?.text || null,
379:       })
380:       if (res.crit) this.log('A critical hit!')
381:       if (effLabel) this.log(effLabel.text)
382:       if (usedSkill.drain && res.damage > 0) {
383:         const heal = Math.max(1, Math.floor(res.damage * usedSkill.drain))
384:         attacker.hp = Math.min(maxHpOf(attacker), attacker.hp + heal)
385:         this.log(`${attackerLabel} drained ${heal} HP!`)
386:       }
387:       if (defender.hp <= 0) break
388:     }
389: 
390:     // secondary effects
391:     this.applySkillEffect(side, usedSkill, false)
392: 
393:     // recoil
394:     if (usedSkill.recoil && attacker.hp > 0) {
395:       const recoil = Math.max(1, Math.floor(attacker.hp * usedSkill.recoil))
396:       attacker.hp = Math.max(0, attacker.hp - recoil)
397:       this.log(`${attackerLabel} is hurt by recoil!`)
398:     }
399: 
400:     // contact passive
401:     if (usedSkill.category === 'physical' && defender.hp > 0 && attacker.hp > 0) {
402:       const defSp = getMonster(defender.speciesId)
403:       const passive = getPassive(defSp.passive)
404:       if (passive.kind === 'contactStatus' && !attacker.status && Math.random() * 100 < passive.chance) {
405:         this.applyStatus(side, passive.status)
406:       }
407:     }
408:   }
409: 
410:   applySkillEffect(side, skill, isStatusMove) {
411:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
412:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
413:     const foeSide = side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player'
414:     // stat changes
415:     if (skill.stat) {
416:       const effects = Array.isArray(skill.stat) ? skill.stat : [skill.stat]
417:       for (const eff of effects) {
418:         const targetSide = eff.target === 'self' ? side : foeSide
419:         this.applyStage(targetSide, eff.stat, eff.stages)
420:         const who = targetSide === 'player' ? this.active.nickname : getMonster(this.enemy.speciesId).name
421:         this.log(`${who}'s ${eff.stat.toUpperCase()} ${stageName(eff.stages)}!`)
422:         this.events.push({ type: 'stage', side: targetSide, stat: eff.stat, stages: this.stageOf(targetSide, eff.stat) })
423:       }
424:     }
425:     if (skill.heal) {
426:       const max = maxHpOf(attacker)
427:       const heal = Math.floor(max * skill.heal)
428:       attacker.hp = Math.min(max, attacker.hp + heal)
429:       if (skill.cure) attacker.status = null
430:       this.log(`${attacker.nickname} restored ${heal} HP!`)
431:       this.events.push({ type: 'heal', side, amount: heal, hp: attacker.hp, maxHp: max })
432:       if (skill.partyHeal) {
433:         for (const m of this.playerParty) {
434:           if (m.uid === attacker.uid || m.hp <= 0) continue
435:           m.hp = Math.min(maxHpOf(m), m.hp + Math.floor(maxHpOf(m) * skill.heal))
436:         }
437:       }
438:     }
439:     if (skill.selfStatus) {
440:       this.applyStatus(side, skill.selfStatus)
441:     }
442:     if (skill.seed) {
443:       this.seeded[foeSide] = true
444:       this.log(`${getMonster(defender.speciesId).name} was seeded!`)
445:       this.events.push({ type: 'seed', side: foeSide })
446:     }
447:     if (skill.status && skill.status.chance > 0) {
448:       if (isStatusMove || Math.random() * 100 < skill.status.chance) {
449:         if (defender.hp > 0 && !defender.status) this.applyStatus(foeSide, skill.status.id)
450:       }
451:     }
452:   }
453: 
454:   applyStatus(side, statusId) {
455:     const target = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
456:     if (target.status) return false
457:     if (side === 'player' && statusId === 'burn' && target.speciesId && getMonster(target.speciesId).element === 'flame') return false
458:     target.status = statusId
459:     target.statusTurns = statusId === 'sleep' ? 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) : statusId === 'freeze' ? 2 : 99
460:     this.log(`${target.nickname} is ${statusId === 'paralysis' ? 'paralyzed' : statusId === 'burn' ? 'burned' : statusId === 'freeze' ? 'frozen' : statusId === 'sleep' ? 'asleep' : 'poisoned'}!`)
461:     this.events.push({ type: 'status', side, status: statusId, label: statusName(statusId) })
462:     return true
463:   }
464: 
465:   statusPreventsAction(side) {
466:     const m = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
467:     if (!m.status) return false
468:     if (m.status === 'sleep') {
469:       m.statusTurns--
470:       if (m.statusTurns <= 0) {
471:         m.status = null
472:         this.log(`${m.nickname} woke up!`)
473:         this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side })
474:         return false
475:       }
476:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is fast asleep.`)
477:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'sleep' })
478:       return true
479:     }
480:     if (m.status === 'freeze') {
481:       if (Math.random() < 0.35 || m.statusTurns-- <= 0) {
482:         m.status = null
483:         this.log(`${m.nickname} thawed out!`)
484:         this.events.push({ type: 'status-clear', side })
485:         return false
486:       }
487:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is frozen solid!`)
488:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'freeze' })
489:       return true
490:     }
491:     if (m.status === 'paralysis' && Math.random() < 0.25) {
492:       this.log(`${m.nickname} is paralyzed and cannot move!`)
493:       this.events.push({ type: 'skip', side, reason: 'paralysis' })
494:       return true
495:     }
496:     return false
497:   }
498: 
499:   calculateDamage(side, skill) {
500:     const attacker = side === 'player' ? this.active : this.enemy
501:     const defender = side === 'player' ? this.enemy : this.active
502:     const defenderSp = getMonster(defender.speciesId)
503:     const defenderPassive = getPassive(defenderSp.passive)
504:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'immuneElement' && defenderPassive.element === skill.element) {
505:       return { damage: 0, effectiveness: 1, crit: false, immune: true }
506:     }
507:     const atkStat = skill.category === 'physical' ? 'atk' : 'spa'
508:     const defStat = skill.category === 'physical' ? 'def' : 'spd'
509:     const A = this.statValue(side, atkStat)
510:     const D = this.statValue(side === 'player' ? 'enemy' : 'player', defStat)
511:     const eff = effectiveness(skill.element, defenderSp.element)
512:     const critChance = 0.0625 + (skill.crit || 0) + (getPassive(getMonster(attacker.speciesId).passive).kind === 'critBoost' ? 0.12 : 0)
513:     const crit = Math.random() < critChance
514:     let mult = eff * (crit ? 1.5 : 1) * (0.88 + Math.random() * 0.12)
515:     // attacker passives
516:     const atkSp = getMonster(attacker.speciesId)
517:     const atkPassive = getPassive(atkSp.passive)
518:     const hpRatio = attacker.hp / maxHpOf(attacker)
519:     const night = isNight(this.state.time.minutes)
520:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'lowHpBoost' && atkPassive.element === skill.element && hpRatio < 1 / 3) mult *= atkPassive.value
521:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'elementBoost' && atkPassive.element === skill.element) mult *= atkPassive.value
522:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'nightBoost' && night) mult *= atkPassive.value
523:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'dayBoost' && !night) mult *= atkPassive.value
524:     if (atkPassive.kind === 'finisher' && defender.hp / maxHpOf(defender) < 0.5) mult *= atkPassive.value
525:     // defender passives
526:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'damageReduce' && defenderPassive.category === skill.category) mult *= defenderPassive.value
527:     if (defenderPassive.kind === 'elementReduce' && defenderPassive.element === skill.element) mult *= defenderPassive.value
528:     const base = (((2 * attacker.level / 5 + 2) * skill.power * A / Math.max(1, D)) / 50 + 2)
529:     let damage = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * mult))
530:     if (damage >= defender.hp && defenderPassive.kind === 'sturdy' && defender.hp === maxHpOf(defender)) damage = defender.hp - 1
531:     return { damage: Math.max(0, damage), effectiveness: eff, crit, immune: false }
532:   }
533: 
534:   chooseEnemyMove() {
535:     const moves = knownMovePool(this.enemy).map((skill, index) => ({ skill, index }))

## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- Current skill elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`; no element or dual-type edits have been made yet.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`.
- Current skill elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`; no element or dual-type edits have been made yet.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`; avoid overwriting them.
- No element or dual-type edits have been made yet; current elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- Recent inspection enumerated all 87 species and confirmed their catalog currently specifies one primary element each.

22: function hexToHsl(hex) {
23:   let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16) / 255
24:   let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16) / 255
25:   let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16) / 255
26:   const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b)
27:   let h = 0, s = 0
28:   const l = (max + min) / 2
29:   if (max !== min) {
30:     const d = max - min
31:     s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min)
32:     switch (max) {
33:       case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0); break
34:       case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break
35:       default: h = (r - g) / d + 4
36:     }
37:     h /= 6
38:   }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`; avoid overwriting them.
- No element or dual-type edits have been made yet; current elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- Recent inspection enumerated all 87 species and confirmed their catalog currently specifies one primary element each.

21: // ── color helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
22: function hexToHsl(hex) {
23:   let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16) / 255
24:   let g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16) / 255
25:   let b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16) / 255
26:   const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b)
27:   let h = 0, s = 0
28:   const l = (max + min) / 2
29:   if (max !== min) {
30:     const d = max - min
31:     s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min)
32:     switch (max) {
33:       case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0); break
34:       case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break
35:       default: h = (r - g) / d + 4
36:     }
37:     h /= 6
38:   }
39:   return [h * 360, s * 100, l * 100]
40: }
41: 
42: function tint(hex, hue = 0, sat = 0, light = 0) {
43:   const [h, s, l] = hexToHsl(hex)
44:   return `hsl(${(h + hue + 360) % 360} ${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s + sat))}% ${Math.max(4, Math.min(96, l + light))}%)`
45: }

49:   const h = hashString(species.id)

51:   p.base = tint(p.base, shift, 0, 0)
52:   p.light = tint(p.light, shift, 0, 1)
53:   p.dark = tint(p.dark, shift, 0, 0)
54:   if (species.look?.accent) p.accent = species.look.accent
55:   return p
56: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.

### Active
- Add element definitions and combined dual-type effectiveness.
- Assign secondary types and update battle logic, species, UI displays and filters, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add element definitions and a combined dual-type effectiveness helper in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and `effectiveness()`.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, and `styles.css`; no element or dual-type edits have been made yet.
- Current elements are `none`, `nature`, `flame`, `frost`, `earth`, `shadow`, `light`, `storm`, and `dragon`; all 87 species currently specify one primary element.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently checks only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering in `src/ui/screens.js`, labels in `src/app.js` and `src/ui/battleUI.js`, palettes in `src/render/sprites.js`, and catch counters in `src/game/state.js` also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
- Earlier JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.

+// Accept both legacy primary-element strings and species records with an optional
+// secondaryElement/elements field so old saves and catalog entries remain valid.
+export function elementTypes(monsterOrElements) {
+  const values = Array.isArray(monsterOrElements)
+    ? monsterOrElements
+    : monsterOrElements && typeof monsterOrElements === 'object'
+      ? (Array.isArray(monsterOrElements.elements)
+        ? monsterOrElements.elements

+      : [monsterOrElements]
+  return [...new Set(values.filter(element => element && ELEMENTS[element]))]

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the monster roster with secondary types and new elements while preserving move access, battle compatibility, and older-save support.
- Combine effectiveness across dual-type defenders and synchronize displayed HP changes with attack animations.

## Requirements
- Add new elements, dual-type species, and matchup behavior that combines effectiveness across defender types.
- Preserve learned and stored moves; use `tackle` if no moves are recorded or a move is unaffordable.
- Maintain compatibility with older or incomplete save records.
- Display player HP changes after the corresponding attack animation.

## Decisions
- Battle move pools combine learned moves and stored moves.
- Unaffordable player moves fall back to `tackle`; enemy fallback uses `tackle` with index `-1`.
- Battle UI tracks displayed HP from events so HP changes align with attack animations.
- `elementTypes()` will accept legacy element strings, species records, or element arrays; `elementNames()` will provide display names.

## Work State
### Completed
- Removed the four-move cap and equipped-move controls; profiles show all available skills.
- Added compatibility for older/incomplete records and a scrollable battle move grid.
- Added eight catalog moves and diversified learnsets; corrected Celestag’s duplicate, Tombwarden’s malformed entry, and Dracoil’s move.
- Checked all 87 learnsets for unknown or duplicate skills and reviewed new species/move assignments.
- Added Water and Metal element definitions plus `elementTypes()` and `elementNames()` helpers in `src/data/elements.js`.

### Active
- Add secondary types and combined dual-type effectiveness across battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
- Preserve previous HP animation timing behavior while updating battle logic.

### Blocked
- No test files or `package.json` were found, so no project test suite is available.

## Next Move
1. Add dual-type effectiveness that multiplies matchup values across defender types in `src/data/elements.js`.
2. Assign secondary types and update battle checks, labels, badges, codex filtering, catch statistics, sprites, and element-based effects.
3. Run JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/elements.js`: Element definitions, matchup chart, and newly added element helpers.
- `src/data/monsters.js`: Species catalog; `M` accepts extra species properties.
- `src/game/battle.js`: Damage, immunity, burn immunity, effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- `src/ui/common.js`: `elementBadge()` currently renders one element.
- `src/ui/screens.js`: Monster profile, codex displays, and element filtering.
- `src/render/sprites.js`: Palette and wing styling currently use the primary element.
- `src/game/state.js`: Catch statistics currently count the primary element.
- `src/game/progress.js`: Element catch objectives read `catchesByElement`.
- `src/app.js`: Starter, guardian, evolution, and other element displays.
- `src/ui/battleUI.js`: Battle metadata and caught-monster element displays.
- `styles.css`: Element badge styles.

## Important Context
- Uncommitted changes are present in `src/data/monsters.js`, `src/data/skills.js`, `src/game/monsters.js`, `src/game/battle.js`, `src/ui/battleUI.js`, `src/ui/screens.js`, `styles.css`, and now `src/data/elements.js`.
- Current catalog has 87 species; all previously specified a single primary element. New Water and Metal types are defined but not yet assigned to species or added to the matchup chart.
- `src/game/battle.js` currently uses only `getMonster(...).element` for burn immunity, damage effectiveness, and enemy move scoring.
- Codex filtering, labels, palettes, and catch counters also assume one element.
- New learnset entries affect new monsters immediately; existing monsters receive newly eligible moves through `syncLearned`, such as on level-up or evolution.
